title: Creative Virtual Assistant & Wedding Culling Assistant (Remote)
description:
Hi! I'm Cescily, the owner of Hyde Photo & Film. I'm a wedding photographer looking for a creative, dependable assistant to help me behind the scenes as my business continues to grow.



This is much more than a typical virtual assistant position. I'm looking for someone who genuinely appreciates beautiful imagery, enjoys organization, and wants to become an important part of a creative business. No wedding photography experience is required,  provide training, detailed workflows, and all of the systems you'll need to succeed.



Your responsibilities may include:

Culling and curating wedding galleries (approximately 3,000–7,000 images per wedding)

Straightening, cropping, and photoshopping images in Lightroom Classic (no editing required)

Assembling Instagram Reels and TikToks from footage I provide

Creating Canva graphics, guides, and client resources

Writing blog posts and helping keep my website updated

Organizing and updating information inside my client management software

Other creative and administrative tasks as my business grows



Every month looks a little different, which keeps the work interesting!

Who I'm Looking For

The right person is someone who:

- Has a strong appreciation for photography, storytelling, and creativity

- Enjoys looking through thousands of wedding images and selecting the very best 
nts

- Has an artistic eye and good attention to detail

- Is organized, dependable, and consistently meets deadlines

- Learns quickly and enjoys improving systems and workflows

- Is proactive and enjoys figuring things out independently while asking questions when needed

- Communicates clearly in English

- Is trustworthy and able to handle client information confidentially

- Has experience with Canva, social media, or other creative software (a plus, but not required)

- Loves movies, music, photography, design, or other creative arts

- I value character, work ethic, and reliability far more than an impressive résumé.



Weekly Schedule

- One requirement for this position is availability every Sunday and Monday (Mountain Time) to complete wedding culling. Finished galleries must be ready for me by Tuesday at 7:00 AM MST.

- Outside of those deadlines, much of the work can be completed on your own schedule.



Hours & Growth

- This position starts at approximately 10 hours per week, although some weeks may be busier than others.



My goal is to begin with a smaller workload while we both become comfortable working together. As trust grows and my business continues to expand, I plan to increase both responsibilities and hours.

The ideal candidate is someone interested in growing into a long-term part-time—and potentially full-time—position. During busy wedding season, full-time work is very possible.

I believe in rewarding people who care about their work. Strong performance, commitment, and growth are recognized with opportunities for increased responsibilities, higher pay, and wage reviews as often as every six months.



This Probably Isn't the Right Fit If...

Please don't apply if you:

- Frequently struggle with organization or deadlines

- Have unreliable internet service

- Are not comfortable communicating in English

- Are looking for a short-term job with little opportunity for growth

- Don't enjoy detailed, repetitive work



How to Apply

If this sounds like a position you'd genuinely enjoy, I'd love to hear from you!

Please include:

Your
 address

Whether you have Lightroom Classic (don't worry if you don't!)

Confirmation that you have a reliable, high-speed internet connection

A little about yourself

What your biggest dream or aspiration is

I look forward to meeting you!

— Cescily

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup

title: Social Media Growth Manager & Content Strategist
description:
We are The Shave Shack, a growing U.S.-based men’s grooming brand with multiple physical locations and an expanding e-commerce business.



We’re looking for an experienced Social Media Growth Manager who can help turn our existing content library and new footage into content that produces measurable business growth.



This is not just a “post every day” position. Our primary goals are:



• Attract new clients to our physical locations

• Increase website traffic and e-commerce product sales

• Recruit talented barbers

• Grow our social media audience and engagement

• Build The Shave Shack into a recognizable men’s lifestyle/grooming brand



You would work directly with our Head of Media, who can provide raw footage and brand direction. We need you to help develop the content strategy, tell us what footage/assets you need, and manage day-to-day execution.



Responsibilities include content planning and strategy, short-form video/reel concepts, captions and CTAs, posting and scheduling across Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube, content repurposing, community engagement, and weekly analytics/reporting.



Experience with video editing, graphic design and AI-generated content is a major plus.



To apply, please include:



1. Your portfolio.

2. Links to 2–3 social accounts you’ve personally managed.

3. An example of how your work helped a business grow—in sales, leads, traffic, customers, or another measurable result.

4. The tools/software you specialize in.

5. Whether you work independently or have a team.

6. Your desired monthly salary for full-time work.



Please begin your application with the words “THE STANDARD” so we know you read the entire posting.



We’re looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can grow with the company. If you’re strong in additional areas such as AI content creation, e-commerce marketing, SEO, paid advertising,
/SMS, or other growth channels, please tell us.

title: Mobile Game Ad Producer
description:
We are a US-based mobile gaming creative agency producing ad content for multiple mobile game clients. We are looking for a skilled part-time producer to join our team on an ongoing monthly basis. This is not a one-time project. If things go well, this becomes a long-term working relationship.

What you will be doing

We provide everything you need to execute: scripts, shot lists, creative briefs, all character and background assets, gameplay footage, and brand guidelines. Your job is to take that material and produce finished ad creative across video and static formats.

On the video side, that means assembling footage in CapCut, applying motion effects, syncing voiceover, cutting to pacing notes, and delivering clean final exports across multiple aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:5). On the static side, that means building polished ad images in Canva using provided assets and layout direction.

You will also be working with AI video and image generation tools as part of the production process. We use Higgsfield (which includes Kling, Seedance, and Wan), ElevenLabs for voiceover, and GPT Image generation for character and scene work. You do not need to know every tool on day one, but you need to be comfortable learning new tools quickly and using AI outputs as production assets rather than finished work.

What a typical month looks like

Roughly one day of work per week. Each month includes a mix of video ads (with different hook variations), static ads across multiple formats, and occasional store asset updates. We deliver a brief, you execute, you submit drafts for review, and we go into a revision round before final delivery.

What we are looking for

Solid CapCut skills, including compositing, transitions, text animation, and multi-format export. Canva proficiency for static ad production. Experience with AI video or image tools, or a clear willingness to learn. Strong attention to file organization, naming conventions, and export specs. Ability to follow a creative brief precisely and flag questions before going too far in the wrong direction. Good English communication, since briefs and feedback are all in English.

A portfolio of video ad work or social media content is required to be considered. Please show us work that demonstrates you can assemble footage, add motion, and deliver a polished final product.

Compensation

$500 USD per month, paid twice monthly via Wise or PayPal. Rate is open to discussion based on experience and portfolio quality.

To apply

Send your portfolio or work samples, a note about your experience with AI creative tools specifically, and two to three sentences about the most relevant work you have done. Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

description:
Graphic Designer – Vehicle Wraps & Large-Format Printing



We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Graphic Designer who specializes in vehicle wraps and large-format print design. This is a remote position for someone who understands how to create professional, production-ready artwork—not just attractive digital graphics.



The ideal candidate has experience designing vehicle wraps, banners, yard signs, window graphics, storefront signage, and other large-format materials. You must be able to follow brand guidelines, work accurately with measurements and templates, and prepare files correctly for printing and installation.

Create full and partial vehicle wrap designs using accurate vehicle templates.

Design large-format graphics, including:

Banners

Yard signs

Window graphics and perforated window film

Storefront signage

Wall graphics

Decals and stickers

Trade show graphics

Other print and signage materials

Prepare clean, production-ready artwork with correct dimensions, scaling, bleeds, margins, and cut paths.

Ensure important text, logos, and design elements are positioned safely around vehicle doors, handles, windows, body lines, and other obstacles.

Review all files carefully for spelling, measurements, alignment, image quality, and print accuracy.

Create realistic mockups and client presentation proofs.

Make revisions based on client or production-team feedback.

Organize design files and follow consistent file-naming standards.

Manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines.

Communicate clearly and provide regular project updates.

Required Qualifications

Proven professional experience in vehicle wrap design and large-format print design.

Strong portfolio showing vehicle wraps, banners, signs, window graphics, or similar production work.

Advanced skills in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.

Strong understanding of vector artwork, high-resolution raster images, fonts, linked files, clipping masks, and outlined text.

Experience preparing artwork in CMYK and creating print-ready PDF, AI, EPS, or other production file formats.

Ability to work with vehicle templates and design files at full size or an accurate scale.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, branding, and visual hierarchy.

Ability to follow instructions and apply feedback accurately.

Good written English and clear communication skills.

Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and the ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with a sign shop, wrap company, commercial printer, or advertising agency.

Knowledge of RIP software and large-format printing workflows.

Familiarity with contour-cut lines, spot colors, panel overlaps, installation considerations, and color matching.

Experience creating customer proofs and realistic vehicle or storefront mockups.

Knowledge of common vehicle-template software or libraries.

We want someone who:



Checks every detail before submitting work.

Understands that large-format design requires technical accuracy.

Takes ownership of projects and meets deadlines.

Asks clear questions when project information is incomplete.

Can balance creativity with print-production requirements.

Produces organized, professional files that are easy for the production team to use.

How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:

3+ years as a hands-on Shopify store manager working inside Shopify admin daily — not a developer, not a strategist

Experience managing multiple Shopify stores simultaneously

title: Part-Time Project Engineer – Cost Tracking & Project Scheduling
description:
Job Title: Part-Time Project Engineer – Cost Tracking & Project Scheduling

Company: Sydney-Based Construction Company

Work Type: Part-Time (20 hours/week) | Long-Term Role

Work Hours: Flexible, with some availability required during Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT), Monday–Friday

________________________________________

About Us

Re Con Building Group is a Sydney-based construction company specialising in high-quality residential renovations, extensions, new homes and duplex developments.

We are looking for a dependable, organised and detail-focused Project Engineer to assist with project cost tracking, back costing, construction scheduling and maintaining accurate project information within our construction management software.

You will work directly with the company director, who is a licensed builder and former structural engineer, to improve the financial tracking, scheduling and administration of our construction projects.

This is a long-term position for someone who understands construction projects and wants to become an important part of a growing Australian building company.

________________________________________

Who We’re Looking For

You are highly organised, comfortable working with numbers and able to understand how construction projects are planned, costed and delivered.

You take ownership of your responsibilities, follow up on missing information and make sure project records remain accurate and up to date.

The ideal candidate has previously worked with a construction company and has experience with tasks such as:

• Project cost tracking

• Back costing and budget reviews

• Construction take-offs

• Transaction allocation

• Project scheduling

• Supplier and subcontractor cost management

Experience working with an Australian construction company is a major advantage.

Double bonus if you have previously worked with a Sydney-based builder or construction company.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

???? Project Cost Tracking & Back Costing

• Track project expenses against budgets and cost categories

• Complete regular back costing for active and completed projects

• Review supplier invoices, subcontractor invoices and project expenses

• Allocate transactions to the correct project and cost category

• Identify transactions that have not yet been allocated

• Assist in identifying cost overruns, budget discrepancies and missing expenses

• Prepare clear weekly project cost summaries for management

• Maintain accurate job-costing records for each construction project

???? Construction Take-Offs & Cost Support

• Assist with quantity take-offs from construction drawings and specifications

• Prepare material quantity lists and basic cost breakdowns

• Review project allowances, supplier pricing and subcontractor costs

• Help maintain project budgets and cost-control spreadsheets

• Compare estimated costs against actual project costs

???? Project Scheduling

• Create and update construction project schedules

• Track project milestones, subcontractor activities and upcoming deadlines

• Update schedules based on site progress and information provided by the director

• Identify potential delays, scheduling conflicts and incomplete activities

• Prepare a clear weekly summary of upcoming project activities

???? Construction Management Software

• Maintain accurate project information within Wunderbuild

• Keep project budgets, expenses, schedules and documentation up to date

• Review the system regularly for missing or incorrectly allocated information

• Upload and organise relevant project documents when required

• Help improve the way Wunderbuild is used across the business

???? Weekly Project Review

You will meet with the company director once each week to:

• Review the previous week’s project transactions

• Confirm that expenses have been allocated correctly

• Allocate any outstanding or unidentified transactions

• Review project budgets and actual costs

• Update construction schedules

• Discuss upcoming project activities and priorities

• Identify any missing information requiring follow-up

You will be expected to prepare the information before the meeting so the review can be completed efficiently.

________________________________________

Qualifications & Skills Required

• Degree or relevant qualification in civil engineering, construction management, quantity surveying, accounting or a related field

• Previous experience working with a construction, building or engineering company

• Experience with project cost tracking, back costing or job costing

• Strong numerical and analytical skills

• Ability to read and understand construction drawings

• Experience completing construction take-offs

• Experience preparing or maintaining project schedules

• Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Highly organised and detail-oriented

• Able to work independently and take ownership of recurring responsibilities

• Comfortable identifying errors, missing information and cost discrepancies

• Reliable internet connection and suitable home-working environment

Preferred Experience

• Experience working with an Australian construction company

• Experience working with a Sydney-based builder or contractor

• Understanding of Australian construction terminology and processes

• Experience with residential renovations, extensions, new homes or duplex developments

• Experience using construction management or job-costing software

• Experience with Wunderbuild, Buildertrend, Procore, Buildxact, Xero or similar systems

• Bookkeeping experience within the construction industry

________________________________________

What We Offer

• Part-time employment of approximately 20 hours per week

• Long-term position with the opportunity to grow

• Opportunity for full time employment

• Competitive salary based on experience and capability

• 13th month pay

• Flexible working arrangements

• Direct training and support from the company director

• Exposure to real residential construction and development projects

• Opportunity to increase your responsibilities as the company grows

• Supportive working relationship with clear weekly priorities

________________________________________

To Apply

Please
 your application to 
 with the subject:

6. Details of any previous experience working with an Australian or Sydney-based company

In your Loom video, please briefly explain:

• Your experience with cost tracking and back costing

• Your experience preparing take-offs or project schedules

• How you ensure financial and project records remain accurate

Applications without a Loom video may not be considered.

________________________________________

???? Onboarding Plan – First Four Weeks

Week Focus Tasks

Week 1 Business & System Orientation Introduction to Re Con Building Group, current projects, cost codes, suppliers, subcontractors and workflows. Begin Wunderbuild training and review existing project information.

Week 2 Transaction Allocation & Cost Tracking Review project transactions, allocate expenses to the correct projects and cost categories, identify missing information and begin preparing weekly cost summaries.

title: Experienced US Land Acquisitions Manager
description:

This is a senior-level opportunity for a VA who is a master of the land investment lifecycle. We are not looking for a general real estate assistant; we need an expert who lives and breathes land. You will be the engine room of our Florida land operations, responsible for everything from identifying undervalued parcels to structuring profitable seller financing deals that generate long-term cashflow. Your deep expertise in due diligence and creating notes will be critical to our success.



Required Tech Stack (Must Have Experience):




 (or sms campaign experience): Daily management of SMS campaigns.

PropStream & Zillow: Rapid market research and running comps.

County GIS Maps: Navigating local county sites for zoning, parcel boundaries, and utility checks.

BuyerBridge.ai: Finding builders and managing buyer lists.

Id.Land: Property mapping and evaluation.

Resimpli CRM: Lead and data management.

Land Insights: For advanced property data and evaluation.


: For rapid due diligence and parcel checks.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Deal Flow & Acquisitions:



* Land Analysis & Comping: Accurately determine the market value of raw land in Florida by rapidly analyzing comparable sales and market data.

* In-Depth Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive due diligence on every potential property using GIS and our tech stack, including:

* Verifying local Florida zoning regulations and land use restrictions.

* Confirming legal and physical access (easements, road frontage).

* Investigating utility availability (water, sewer/septic, electricity).

* Checking for wetlands, flood zones, topography issues, and other potential restrictions.

* Acquisitions: Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements with American sellers, with a strong focus on acquiring properties using seller financing. (must have excellent communications skills and speak very fluent English)

* Structure Creative Deals: Architect and structure seller financing (note) terms for both buying land from original owners and selling it to end buyers.

* Pitch Seller Financing: Expertly explain the benefits of seller financing to property owners to get more deals accepted over cash offers.





Qualifications and Experience:



Experience: Minimum 2+ years of direct, hands-on experience as a VA specifically in the US LAND INVESTING niche. (This is a strict, non-negotiable requirement).



Mastery of Due Diligence: You must know exactly what to look for and what questions to ask to determine a property's true value and usability.



Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Florida markets and county zoning sites is highly preferred. Experience with RV Parks or Manufactured Homes is a huge plus.



Communication: Fluent English (Speaking and Writing). Exceptional negotiation skills; you must be confident and persuasive when building rapport on the phone.



Autonomy: Highly organized, systems-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously with zero hand-holding.



Bonus: Experience with selling performing notes to third-party note buyers.



What We Offer:



Premium Compensation: We offer a highly competitive base salary plus a significant performance-based BONUS for every profitable deal you manage. Your income is directly tied to the value you create.



Leadership Role: You won't be just another VA; you will be a key leader in building our land business from the ground up.



Autonomy & Trust: We are looking for an expert we can trust to run the process. You will have the autonomy to make decisions and implement your strategies.



Long-Term Stability & Growth: This is a long-term position with a company that is committed to growing and investing in its team.



How to Apply:



Describe your land due diligence process. What are the top 5 most critical things you look for before recommending the purchase of a rural, vacant land parcel?



Explain, as if you were speaking to a property owner over the phone, the benefits for them to sell their land to us using seller financing instead of waiting for a full cash offer.



How many years of experience do you have in Land acquisitions and dispositions?



Do you have experience with SmarterContact or Launch Control?



List one specific Florida county or city you have worked in previously.



Have you done any creative financing or seller financing deals?



Do you have any experience with subdividing land or doing lot splits?



Do you also have experience with houses (not just land)?



We have both weekly hours and weekend hours available. Please specify which hours interest you the most.



Applications that do not include thoughtful answers to these 5 questions will be immediately disqualified. This is your chance to prove your expertise. We look forward to reviewing your application! Send a recording of yourself negotiating with a seller if you have a recording on hand, please. Thank you for applying.

title: Grant Writer
description:
Grant Writer (Part-Time)

10–20 Hours Per Week | $5/hour

Opportunity to Transition to Full-Time After 6 Months (Performance-Based)



About ArtyHood:

ArtyHood creates vibrant, inclusive spaces where artists, businesses, and communities connect, grow, and thrive.



Through art shows, night markets, block parties, and cultural festivals, we help revitalize neighborhoods, support small businesses, and empower LGBTQ+, BIPOC, immigrant, and underrepresented artists.



We believe art is infrastructure. It drives economic opportunity. It strengthens community identity. It transforms public space into places of belonging.



To expand this impact, we’re looking for a mission-aligned Grant Writer who can help secure the funding that sustains and grows our programs.



The Role:

We’re seeking a resourceful, strategic, and detail-oriented fundraising professional who can identify, pursue, and manage grant opportunities that support ArtyHood’s:

- Public art markets and cultural festivals

- Artist workforce development initiatives

- Neighborhood revitalization efforts

- Community-based creative programs



This role is ideal for someone who understands that fundraising is not just about securing money — it’s about fueling cultural ecosystems and building long-term community infrastructure.



What You’ll Do:

- Research and identify grant opportunities from federal, state, local, and private funders

- Write compelling grant proposals, LOIs, and funding applications

- Develop budgets, impact statements, and project narratives

- Maintain a grants calendar to ensure timely submissions and reporting

- Track awarded grants, deliverables, and compliance requirements

- Collaborate with leadership to identify funding priorities and measurable outcomes

- Translate community impact into strong, data-informed storytelling

- Support fundraising strategies tied to events, activations, and expansion initiatives



Who You Are:

- Passionate about arts, culture, and community revitalization

- Mission-driven and aligned with equity and representation

- Experienced in grant writing, fundraising, or philanthropic partnerships

- A strong writer who can clearly communicate mission, metrics, and impact

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple deadlines

- Proactive and strategic in identifying funding opportunities

- Comfortable working in a growing, entrepreneurial nonprofit environment



Ideal Qualifications:

- Proven experience securing foundation or government grants

- Strong English writing and persuasive storytelling skills

- Familiarity with nonprofits, arts organizations, workforce development, or community programs

- Experience preparing program budgets and measurable impact frameworks

- Ability to manage documentation, deadlines, and reporting cycles independently



Growth Opportunity:

This is a part-time position (10–20 hours per week) at $5/hour, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time leadership role after 6 months based on performance and funding growth.



As ArtyHood expands, this role has the potential to grow into a Development Lead or Director-level position.



*Important Application Instruction:

To ensure you’ve carefully read this entire job post, please begin your message with the exact phrase: “Creativity Builds Community”. Applications that do not start with this exact phrase will not be reviewed.



If you’re excited about using fundraising as a tool to empower artists, revitalize neighborhoods, and build inclusive creative ecosystems — we’d love to hear from you.



Please send your resume, cover letter (or message), and 1–2 relevant writing samples.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & P&L Reporting Specialist
description:
QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper for RV Rental and Vacation Rental (AirBnb) Businesses



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented part time bookkeeper to organize and clean up our financial records for 2025 and then manage our bookkeeping on an ongoing monthly basis.  In addition you will be required to prepare and provide P and L Statements



We operate two businesses in the United States:



An RV rental business with multiple vehicles

A short-term vacation rental business with one property.



You would use QuickBooks Online. We need someone who can accurately categorize transactions, reconcile accounts and produce clear profit-and-loss reports that help us understand how each business is performing.



This will begin as a part-time position; in the beginning, there will be more work and therefore more hours to do (as you will provide P and L Statements for 2025.  Once caught up, demand and hours will be slightly 



Initial Project: 2025 Bookkeeping Cleanup



Your first responsibility will be to organize and complete our bookkeeping for 2025.



This will include:



Reviewing and categorizing income and expenses

Reconciling bank and credit-card accounts

Identifying duplicate, missing or incorrectly categorized transactions

Separating personal and business expenses when necessary

Organizing transactions between the RV rental and vacation rental businesses

Producing accurate 2025 profit-and-loss statements

Preparing the books for review by our U.S.-based accountant

Creating a list of any missing documents or questions that require the owner’s input

Ongoing Monthly Responsibilities



After the 2025 cleanup is complete, responsibilities will include:



Maintaining QuickBooks Online

Categorizing transactions weekly or monthly

Reconciling all bank and credit-card accounts

Recording income from booking platforms and direct reservations

Matching deposits with the correct reservations

Reviewing expenses for accuracy

Producing monthly profit-and-loss statements

Producing separate reports for each business

Tracking income and expenses by RV, property or business category when possible

Identifying unusual expenses, missing payments or discrepancies

Keeping the books organized and ready for tax preparation

Providing a brief monthly summary explaining the results

Types of Transactions You May Work With



Our income and expenses may involve platforms and categories such as:



Airbnb

Vrbo

Outdoorsy

RVshare

Direct bookings

Cleaning expenses

Repairs and maintenance

Vehicle expenses

Insurance

Registration and licensing

Property utilities

Supplies and guest amenities

Platform commissions and processing fees

Security deposits

Refunds and damage charges



Experience with short-term rentals, property management, vehicle rentals or hospitality businesses would be a major advantage.



Required Qualifications

Strong experience using QuickBooks Online

At least two years of bookkeeping experience

Experience completing bank and credit-card reconciliations

Ability to prepare and explain profit-and-loss statements

Strong attention to detail

Excellent written English and good verbal communication in English is preferred 

Ability to identify and communicate discrepancies

Comfortable asking questions when information is unclear

Reliable internet connection

Able to protect confidential financial information

Preferred Qualifications

QuickBooks Online certification

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses

Experience with short-term rentals or RV rental businesses is beneficial

Experience organizing overdue or incomplete bookkeeping

Familiarity with classes, locations, projects or tracking categories in QuickBooks

Experience preparing books for a CPA or tax accountant

Hours and Compensation



This is initially a part-time position.



The 2025 cleanup may require additional hours during the first few weeks. Once the books are current, we expect the ongoing workload to be approximately 5–10 hours per week, depending on transaction volume.



Starting compensation: $6:50 - $ 7.00 USD per hour, based on experience.



We are also open to discussing a fixed monthly amount after the initial cleanup is completed and the ongoing workload is understood.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief summary of your bookkeeping experience.

How many years you have used QuickBooks Online.

Whether you are QuickBooks certified.

Any experience you have with short-term rentals, property management, hospitality or vehicle rental companies.

An example of how you would organize two different businesses inside QuickBooks Online.

Your preferred hourly rate.

Your weekly availability.

The words “RV and Rental Books” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire posting.



Please also answer this question:



A business receives a $2,000 booking deposit, but the booking platform deducts a $300 commission and deposits $1,700 into the bank account. How would you record this in QuickBooks Online?



We are looking for someone who wants a dependable, long-term position and takes pride in keeping accurate and organized financial records.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

Creating high-converting ads, not just aesthetic edits

Producing 3 hooks per video

Turning our raw ideas + strategy into scroll-stopping creatives

Iterating based on performance data

Working directly with me — fast feedback, fast decisions

Helping push the brand from “doing well” to dominating

Full-time, remote role

For strong performers, monthly bonuses can realistically reach around $1,000, depending on output and performance. There’s no fixed cap — results drive upside. If you make winning ads, you make more money. When the brand wins, you win.

title: 3D Designer (3D + AI Hybrid) — E-Commerce Creative Agency | Multiple Projects Monthly
description:
About Us



We are a full-service e-commerce creative agency working with brands across North America, Europe, and beyond. We produce branding, packaging, web design, and high-end product visuals for DTC brands in wellness, fragrance, skincare, and food. Our visual bar is very high — our clients expect renders that look like premium product photography.



The Role



We're looking for a talented 3D Designer who can handle multiple projects per month and deliver consistent, high-quality work across:





3D Modeling — accurate product modeling from photos, dielines, or sketches (bottles, jars, pouches, boxes, supplements, cosmetics, etc.)

Texturing & Shading — realistic materials: glass, plastic, metal, matte/gloss labels, liquids, powders

Photorealistic Renders — hero shots, packshots, lifestyle compositions with studio-quality lighting

Environments & Scenes — building full 3D environments and product staging (podiums, nature scenes, kitchens, bathrooms, abstract sets)

3D Animation / Video — product turntables, camera fly-throughs, liquid/particle simulations, short ad-ready product videos

AI-Assisted Workflows — we fully embrace AI (image generation, upscaling, background creation, video tools). You can mix 3D and AI freely — as long as the final result is clean, consistent, and high quality





Important: Attention to Detail



We know the difference between a real 3D render and a lazy AI output. We can spot warped text, melted logos, inconsistent reflections, and fake-looking labels instantly. If you use AI, it must be integrated professionally — correct branding, correct proportions, sharp typography, believable lighting. Quality is non-negotiable.



Requirements





Strong portfolio showing product renders, environments, AND at least one 3D animation/video

Proficiency in at least one main 3D software: Blender, Cinema 4D, or 3ds Max

Render engine experience: Cycles, Octane, Redshift, Corona, or similar

Bonus: experience with AI tools (Midjourney, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Flux, etc.)

Bonus: compositing/post skills (Photoshop, After Effects)

Able to handle several projects per month with reliable turnaround times

Good communication in English, responsive on Slack/WhatsApp

Able to take feedback and do revisions without ego





What We Offer





Steady flow of projects every month (long-term collaboration, not one-off gigs)

Work with real international brands — portfolio-worthy projects

Creative freedom on execution as long as quality is there

Flexible hours — we care about output, not time tracking

Growth: our best designers become our go-to leads





How to Apply





Start your application with the word "RENDER" so we know you read this post

Send your portfolio link (Behance, ArtStation, Google Drive, or website) — applications without a portfolio will be ignored

Tell us: which 3D software + render engine you use, and which AI tools (if any) you work with

Include 1–2 examples of your best product render and your best 3D video/animation

Your expected monthly salary





We review every application with a portfolio. Talented artists will hear back within a few days.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
The Company You’ll Join



OCD Anxiety Centers has a true passion for bringing help and hope to some of the most underserved clinical populations. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families who have been suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. We are an evidence-based practice, which means we do what works, we stay up to date with scientific research, and we regularly attend international training to keep us at our very best.





The Team You’ll Work With



The success of our organization is dependent on the trust and confidence we earn from our employees, clients, and community. Our values are connected to our work at OCD Anxiety Centers and are measured against the highest possible standards of ethical business conduct.



* We act with integrity and communicate honestly and openly

* We are passionate about meeting the company’s needs and delivering for our clients

* We are accountable for all our own actions

* We work together as a team and are committed to excellence and innovation

* We respect each other and celebrate our diversity



The Purpose of your Role



The Financial Analyst leads enterprise FP&A, management reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and decision support across 10 companies in a fast-growing mental health organization. The role translates financial and operating data into insights for the Controller and business leaders, builds scalable models and dashboards, and supports growth, labor, profitability, cash flow, and resource-allocation decisions.



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting



* Monthly management reporting and budget-to-actual, forecast, and prior-year variance analyses are completed within the approved calendar with at least 98?ta and formula accuracy.

* Annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-range plans are completed on schedule, with assumptions documented and reconciled to source systems and the general ledger.

* Consolidated and entity forecasts for revenue, labor, operating expense, EBITDA, cash, and headcount meet approved accuracy thresholds, with material variances explained and actions identified.

* Financial and operational dashboards for clinician capacity, utilization, productivity, staffing, revenue, sales, and entity performance are refreshed on schedule and reconcile to approved data.

* Decision-support models and scenarios are delivered by agreed deadlines with clear assumptions, sensitivities, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.

* Quarterly improvements are implemented or proposed for automation, data quality, reporting clarity, controls, and forecast efficiency.

* Upon achieving these key performance indicators, your supervisor will meet with you to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth and excellence.





Core Competencies



* Demonstrate advanced knowledge of FP&A, driver-based forecasting, budgeting, financial modeling, management reporting, and performance measurement.

* Demonstrate strong business acumen and the ability to connect operating drivers to financial results across a multi-entity, multi-state, high-growth organization.

* Demonstrate executive-ready communication, data storytelling, sound judgment, confidentiality, accountability, and constructive challenge.

* Demonstrate advanced Excel capability, systems and data discipline, and the ability to build repeatable models, dashboards, scorecards, and documentation.

* Demonstrate calm urgency, independent problem-solving, cross-functional influence, and prompt escalation of material risks, opportunities, or data limitations.



Core Responsibilities:



Primary Role Execution

* Lead consolidated and entity-level annual budgeting, monthly rolling forecasts, and long-range planning for 10 companies, including assumptions, submissions, reviews, and final reporting.

* Build driver-based models for revenue, clinician capacity and utilization, productivity, labor and headcount, benefits, sales, operating expense, growth, profitability, EBITDA, and cash flow.

* Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, prior year, and operating drivers; identify root causes, quantify impacts, and recommend performance actions.

* Prepare executive reporting packages, dashboards, presentations, and commentary that clearly communicate performance, trends, risks, opportunities, and outlook.

* Provide decision support for hiring, compensation, pricing, resource allocation, market expansion, contracts, capital needs, and strategic initiatives or diligence as assigned.



Financial Planning, Reporting and Systems

* Maintain controlled models and reports with clear source data, assumptions, version history, review evidence, and reconciliation to the general ledger and approved systems.

* Use advanced Excel, NetSuite or an equivalent ERP, Paycom and other operating data, and BI or planning tools to integrate data and automate recurring analysis and reporting.

* Partner with Accounting during close to validate results, review accruals and classifications, investigate material variances, and improve management reporting.

* Develop standard KPI definitions, data-quality checks, dashboards, scorecards, procedures, and controls that make planning and reporting scalable and repeatable.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with the Controller and Finance, Accounting, HR, Clinical, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and other leaders to translate strategy into measurable assumptions and forecasts.

* Lead or support business performance reviews, challenge assumptions constructively, document decisions and actions, and update forecasts as information changes.

* Escalate material risks, opportunities, missing data, unclear ownership, control concerns, or forecast changes with quantified impact and recommended next steps.



Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, data analytics, or a related field required; MBA, master's degree, CPA, or CFA preferred.

* 5+ years of progressive FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or financial analysis experience, including complex modeling and executive reporting.

* Experience leading budgets, rolling forecasts, long-range plans, management reporting, and variance analysis for a multi-entity, multi-location, or high-growth organization.

* Advanced Excel required, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, Power Query or similar tools, scenario analysis, and driver-based modeling.

* Strong understanding of the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, GAAP reporting, and the link between operating metrics and financial outcomes.

* ERP experience required; NetSuite strongly preferred. Power BI, Tableau, Adaptive Planning, Planful, Anaplan, or similar BI or planning tools are preferred.

* Healthcare, behavioral health, multi-site services, private-equity-backed, or other high-growth experience preferred; Paycom or other HRIS data experience is a plus.

* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills required; must meet Company background, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.



Skills and Expertise

* FP&A; driver-based budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning; three-statement, scenario, and sensitivity modeling; management reporting and KPI analysis; advanced Excel; ERP, BI, and planning tools; data visualization; executive communication; multi-entity analysis; automation; and controls.



Physical Demands

* Regularly sit, stand, walk, talk, hear, type, and view computer screens for extended periods.

* Communicate by phone, video,
, messaging, and in person with employees, leaders, vendors, and internal departments.

* Protect confidential health, employee, financial, strategic, and company information.



Reporting



Daily

* Material exceptions affecting revenue, labor, headcount, cash, volume, forecasts, data feeds, or reporting deadlines.

* Time-sensitive model, dashboard, and data-quality updates required for leadership decisions, forecasts, or close.

* Same-day escalation of material variances, forecast risks, data failures, control concerns, or business changes.



Weekly

* Performance pulse covering revenue, clinician utilization, productivity, labor, headcount, sales, cash, and entity trends.

* Forecast assumptions, decisions, data dependencies, and action items with owners, due dates, and impacts.

* FP&A projects, models, dashboards, automation, and reporting deliverables against the approved calendar.



Monthly

* Consolidated and entity management reporting: income statement, cash-flow insights, variances, KPIs, and commentary.

* Rolling forecast and bridge for revenue, labor, operating expense, EBITDA, cash, headcount, and key drivers.

* Profitability and performance analysis by company, region, location, department, or service line.

* Model, dashboard, and source-data reconciliation, quality review, and unresolved-item plan.

* Quarterly and annual, as due: reforecasts, scenarios, long-range plan, annual budget, leadership or board support, and improvement roadmap.







Disclaimer

OCD Anxiety Centers has not designed this job description to contain a comprehensive list of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. The Company may change, remove, or assign duties, responsibilities, and activities at any time, with or without notice, based on business needs, growth, compliance requirements, and operational priorities.

OCD Anxiety Centers is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Legal Recruiter – US Market
description:
About the opportunity



Relativity is an operator-led recruiting and executive-search firm seeking a Philippines-based legal recruiter to support our US legal-search practice. You will help identify and engage attorneys, paralegals and other legal professionals for law firm and corporate clients. You can learn more about us at: 



**Please note: This is not a general virtual assistant position.** The work requires research, sound judgment, clear written communication and the measured persistence to engage passive candidates who are not actively applying for jobs.



You do not need to be an expert in the US legal market on day one. We will provide training, search criteria, recruiting tools and direct support. You should already understand passive candidate sourcing and be able to explain why a candidate does or does not fit a search.



The position begins as a 20-hour-per-week independent contractor engagement. Our goal is to develop the right person into a full-time member of the firm after approximately six months, based on performance and mutual fit.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of a search—not simply execute a list of tasks. You should be able to translate a search brief into a recruiting strategy, evaluate whether that strategy is working and make thoughtful adjustments when the pipeline is not producing the right candidates.



What you will do



- Translate client requirements into a practical search and candidate-engagement strategy.

- Take ownership of assigned searches from initial research through qualified candidate engagement and handoff.

- Build targeted candidate lists using LinkedIn and other recruiting platforms.

- Identify attorneys, paralegals and legal professionals who match specific client requirements.

- Review employment history, practice area, seniority, tenure and other relevant experience rather than relying only on job titles or keywords.

- Conduct personalized outreach to passive candidates through approved channels.

- Follow up consistently and professionally with candidates who do not initially respond.

- Re-engage qualified candidates who have previously been contacted but were not successfully reached.

- Evaluate search results and adjust target employers, search criteria, channels, messaging and follow-up strategy as needed.

- Identify pipeline problems, candidate objections and market constraints early, then recommend a practical response.

- Maintain accurate and timely records in our applicant tracking and recruiting systems.

- Track outreach activity, responses, interested candidates and conversion through the recruiting process.

- Participate in regular search-review and training meetings.

- Protect confidential candidate, client and business information.



Initially, the firm will manage candidate interviews, client submissions and closing. As you demonstrate judgment and market knowledge, there will be an opportunity to take on more responsibility.



What we are looking for



Required



- At least five years of experience in recruiting, candidate sourcing, recruitment research or a closely related role.

- Experience sourcing candidates for US employers, staffing firms or RPO organizations.

- Demonstrated ability to find and engage passive candidates, not only screen inbound applicants.

- Demonstrated ability to independently develop and adjust recruiting strategies based on search results and market feedback.

- Strong LinkedIn research, Boolean search and internet research skills.

- Clear, professional written and spoken English.

- Good judgment and the ability to assess a profile against detailed requirements.

- The ability to manage multiple priorities and remain accountable for outcomes, not just activity.

- Strong organization, follow-through and attention to detail.

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection and a professional remote-work environment.

- Availability for 20 hours per week, including a reasonable amount of agreed overlap with US business hours.

- Willingness to disclose other recruiting clients or assignments that could create a conflict of interest.



Preferred



- Experience recruiting attorneys, paralegals or other professional-services candidates.

- Experience with US staffing, executive search or RPO delivery.

- Familiarity with an ATS or recruiting CRM.

- Experience writing personalized candidate outreach and tracking response and conversion rates.



Legal recruiting experience is helpful, but it is not required. Research ability, sourcing discipline, communication and judgment matter more.



Schedule



This is a 20-hour-per-week position with a flexible schedule. You must be available for at least two hours of overlap between **9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (New York), Monday through Thursday**, including one scheduled weekly meeting. Remaining hours may be completed flexibly, provided deadlines and agreed response times are met.



Compensation and performance expectations



First 90 days



- **$750 USD monthly base compensation** for a 20-hour-per-week commitment.

- **10% commission on eligible placement revenue collected by the firm.**

- Tools, subscriptions, training and search support provided.

- Performance objective: contribute to **two successful placements during the first 90 days**.



After successful completion of the first 90 days



- Monthly base compensation increases to **$900 USD**.

- Uncapped placement commission with higher rates earned through stronger production after 90 days.

- Expanded responsibility and earning potential as you demonstrate consistency.

- Formal review at approximately six months for potential conversion to a full-time position.



Placement commissions are governed by the contractor agreement and are paid on eligible fees collected by the firm. Full details will be reviewed before an offer is accepted.



How success will be measured



We will evaluate both activity and results, including:



- Accuracy and quality of candidate research.

- Quality and practicality of the strategy developed for each assigned search.

- Qualified candidates identified and engaged.

- Outreach quality, response rates and follow-up discipline.

- Ability to identify why a search is underperforming and make sound adjustments.

- Reliable documentation in the recruiting system.

- Communication, responsiveness and coachability.

- Contribution to interviews, submissions and successful placements.



We value accurate, thoughtful sourcing over sending a high volume of poorly matched profiles.



How to apply



Use the subject line **Legal Recruiter – [Your Years of Recruiting Experience]** and include:



1. Your resume and LinkedIn profile.

2. A brief summary of the US roles or industries you have recruited for.

3. The sourcing tools and recruiting systems you have used.

4. A specific example of a difficult passive candidate you successfully engaged. Explain your approach and the result.

5. An example of a search strategy that was not producing the right candidates. Explain how you diagnosed the problem, what you changed and the result.

6. A short explanation of how you determine whether a candidate fits a role beyond matching titles and keywords.

7. Your current work commitments and your availability for 20 hours per week.

8. A link to a 60–90 second audio or video introduction describing why this role is a strong fit for your experience.



Finalists will be invited to complete a short **paid search-strategy, sourcing and candidate-assessment exercise** before a hiring decision is made.

title: Experienced Philippines-Based Attorney Needed for Florida Landlord / Premises Liability Case
description:
We are pro se plaintiffs in an active Broward County, Florida civil case involving landlord liability, unsafe rental-property conditions, personal injuries, damages, discovery, and trial preparation.



We are seeking an experienced Philippines-based attorney to provide high-level behind-the-scenes litigation support. This is not a virtual-assistant or document-formatting role. We need someone with real litigation experience, strong English writing skills, and the ability to help organize and prepare a serious case for mediation, pretrial deadlines, and trial.



## Case Background



The case involves damages arising from a rented property, including alleged unsafe housing conditions, failure to repair, personal injuries, medical treatment, and loss of consortium. The available insurance coverage appears to be approximately $100,000, but we believe the damages may exceed that amount if properly supported by evidence and Florida law.



## What We Need Help With



The selected attorney will help us:



* Review pleadings, court orders, discovery, medical records, photos, communications, and prior attorney work

* Identify strengths, weaknesses, missing evidence, and procedural risks

* Build a clear case chronology and trial-preparation plan

* Review landlord-liability, premises-liability, and damages issues

* Organize medical records and damages evidence

* Help analyze damages above the apparent $100,000 insurance issue, where legally supported

* Assist with discovery issues, expert needs, mediation preparation, and pretrial documents

* Prepare first drafts of motions, notices, legal memoranda, hearing notes, witness outlines, exhibit lists, and trial materials



## Required Experience



Applicants must be attorneys with meaningful litigation experience.



Preferred experience includes:



* U.S. civil litigation support

* Florida civil litigation support

* Landlord-tenant or rental-property disputes

* Premises liability

* Personal injury damages

* Medical-record review

* Discovery and trial preparation

* Mediation preparation

* Legal research and drafting for U.S. attorneys or pro se litigants



Florida-specific experience is strongly preferred.



## What We Are Looking For



We need someone who can think like a litigator, not just rewrite documents.



You must be able to:



* Analyze facts and evidence

* Research Florida law accurately

* Verify every case, rule, statute, and citation

* Separate strong arguments from weak ones

* Identify what is missing before trial

* Organize a messy case file

* Draft clearly and professionally

* Meet deadlines

* Maintain strict confidentiality



No fabricated cases, invented citations, or unsupported legal conclusions.



## Important Scope Limitation



This is a behind-the-scenes litigation-support role.



Unless you are licensed in Florida, you will not appear in court, sign pleadings, act as attorney of record, communicate with opposing counsel as our attorney, or engage in the unauthorized practice of Florida law.



Final filings and court decisions will remain with the pro se plaintiffs and any Florida-licensed attorney retained for limited-scope review.



## Paid Test Assignment



The first assignment will be a paid case-review project. You may be asked to review key documents and provide:



* A case status report

* A damages assessment

* A list of strengths, weaknesses, and missing evidence

* A trial-readiness plan

* Recommendations for next steps



## How to Apply



Begin your application with:



**FLORIDA LANDLORD DAMAGES CASE**



Then briefly answer:



1. Are you an attorney, and where are you admitted?

2. What U.S. or Florida litigation experience do you have?

3. Have you worked on landlord, premises liability, personal injury, or damages cases?

4. Have you reviewed medical records or prepared damages summaries?

5. Have you helped prepare cases for mediation or trial?

6. What legal research tools do you use?

7. What is your hourly rate or fixed-fee proposal for the paid test assignment?

8. When can you begin?



Generic applications will not be considered.



We are looking for a serious, focused, experienced attorney who can help us bring order, strategy, and discipline to a Florida civil case as we prepare for mediation, pretrial deadlines, and trial.

description:

Company: GuestFish LLC — boutique short-term rental management, SF Bay Area + Copperopolis. ~15-20 properties, scaling to 30.

This role owns two connected functions for a growing short-term rental portfolio: bookkeeping/financial tracking and purchasing/administrative execution. You'll keep the books accurate and current — daily expense categorization, vendor payment tracking, the master ledger — while also managing non-routine purchasing and administrative operations day to day. Bookkeeping & financial tracking:



Daily/weekly bookkeeping in QuickBooks — categorize and log all expenses, keep books current

Own the master purchase/expense ledger across the portfolio

Receive vendor/contractor payment records (forwarded via WhatsApp/email/text) and log same-day

Reconcile accounts and flag discrepancies



Purchasing & administrative operations:

Handle administrative coordination and documentation as systems improve

Support process improvement across both functions

Bookkeeping experience, comfortable in QuickBooks

Ability to make and receive US phone calls (VoIP tools like Google Voice or OpenPhone are fine — no US phone number needed, just reliable calling with clear audio and a professional phone manner)

Comfortable handling confidential financial information with high integrity

Strong written English

Self-motivated — this role requires chasing gaps proactively, not waiting for instructions

Daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT or similar)

Excellent follow-through

Must be available and online during California business hours (9am-6pm PT) — Philippines-based candidates or others confirmed available on PT hours only



Preferred:



Short-term rental / property management / hospitality experience

Purchasing/inventory management background

Experience supporting entrepreneurs or small business owners

Process improvement track record



Tools you'll use: QuickBooks, Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Gmail), Excel, Hospitable, Airbnb, VRBO, WhatsApp, Slack, Amazon/Walmart/Wayfair/Costco/Home Depot/Lowe's, AI tools

Access model: Staged over your first 90 days — starts with purchasing/admin tools, expands to financial systems as trust is established. Standard for the role, not a reflection of you.

Success in 6 months:



Books current and accurate at all times, not reconstructed at month-end

Vendor/contractor payments fully tracked with no gaps

Purchasing handled independently for non-routine items

Owner's admin workload reduced ~20 hrs/week



Screening questions:

How do you use AI tools (ChatGPT, etc.) in your daily work?

Describe your experience handling confidential financial information.

Briefly describe how you'd follow up with a US vendor who hasn't responded to a text — would you call, and how would that conversation go?

What are your long-term career goals?



Required with application: Resume, references, short intro video (30-60 sec) — listen for phone/spoken English clarity, not just writing.

Finalists: Paid practical assessment — a real reconciliation task (sample vendor records + calendar, build a mini ledger, flag mismatches).

title: Backlink Outreach Specialist — Performance-Based SEO Role
description:
Job Title: Backlink Outreach Specialist — Performance-Based SEO Role



Rate: $5–$8/hour, depending on experience and output

Hours: Part-time, flexible — 5–10 hours per week

Payment: Weekly via PayPal

Location: Remote, contractor role



About the Work

We're a multi-business marketing agency managing SEO across B2B and ecommerce sites including TriHaz Solutions (medical waste compliance), Plastic Fusion (industrial geomembranes), Bear Brothers Cleaning, The Trade Table, and Sharps Disposal Containers. We're scaling our backlink outreach operation and looking for 1–2 specialists to source and secure quality placements across our portfolio.



This is a performance-based role — earnings scale with the volume and quality of links you secure. Top performers move into expanded scopes and higher compensation tiers.



This is not a content-writing role. This is sourcing, outreach, negotiation, and securing placements.



IMPORTANT — Please read before applying:



A trial task IS REQUIRED for this role. This is non-negotiable.



We have seen complaints suggesting this is a scam — it is not. We have hired three people for this exact role through this exact process. The trial task exists for one reason: to see your actual skill level. The majority of applicants submit very poor quality links and are removed from the process at this stage, which is exactly the point.



We do not use, build, or benefit from any links submitted during the trial. They are reviewed for quality only. If we do build them, you will be compensated. 



If you are not willing to complete a trial task, please do not apply. If you are confident in your skills, this is your chance to stand out and get hired.



How It Works



You source backlink opportunities relevant to one of our businesses

You handle outreach and negotiate terms with the publisher

You send us the offer package for approval (details below)

Once approved, we proceed and the link goes live and gets verified





Backlink Requirements

Every backlink we accept must be:



White-hat only — no PBNs, link farms, or spam networks

Relevant to the business/industry — niche fit matters

A new referring domain — not already in our backlink profile

Live and verified — we don't accept promised links, only live ones

Quality publisher — DR 30+ preferred, must rank for actual industry keywords (not just brand terms)





Offer Package Format

For every opportunity you submit for approval, include:



Website/domain + the exact page where the link will be placed

Placement type (guest post, niche edit, resource page, directory, etc.)

Price/terms (publisher fee, what's included)

Requirements (content length, topic, anchor rules, turnaround time)

Estimated timeline to go live





What You Bring



Existing relationships with publishers in industrial, healthcare/compliance, home services, or ecommerce niches preferred

Knowledge of how to vet a domain (DR, traffic, ranking keywords vs. brand-only ranking)

Strong written outreach skills

Self-directed — we don't hand-feed targets





How to Apply

 
 with subject line "Backlink Outreach Specialist — [Your Name]"

Include:



Brief overview of your backlink outreach experience — specific niches and total links built

2 sample backlinks you've built in the past — domain, page URL, and what placement type

IQ test result from 
/take-the-test/ (free,
ed to you — paste the score in your application)

Your PayPal
 and preferred contact method



If you're a fit, we'll add you to our agency Slack and you can start sourcing immediately. First task: source 2 backlink offers each for 
 and 
 to demonstrate fit. Compensation structure is fully transparent and discussed in detail during onboarding.
