title: Payroll Manager
description:
***MUST HAVE PAYCOM EXPERIENCE***



The Company You’ll Join

OCD Anxiety Centers has a true passion for bringing help and hope to some of the most underserved clinical populations. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families who have been suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. We are an evidence-based practice, which means we do what works, we stay up to date with scientific research, and we regularly attend international training to keep us at our very best.







The Team You’ll Work With

The success of our organization is dependent on the trust and confidence we earn from our employees, clients, and community. Our values are connected to our work at OCD Anxiety Centers and are measured against the highest possible standards of ethical business conduct.



* We act with integrity and communicate honestly and openly

* We are passionate about meeting the company’s needs and delivering for our clients

* We are accountable for all our own actions

* We work together as a team and are committed to excellence and innovation

* We respect each other and celebrate our diversity





The Purpose of your Role

The Payroll Manager owns accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations for 10 companies across multiple states in a rapidly growing mental health organization. This hands-on leader initially processes all payroll elements while building scalable Paycom workflows, controls, reconciliations, reporting, and team capability for clinicians, sales, and administrative employees.



* Key Performance Indicators and Reporting

* All regular and off-cycle payrolls across 10 companies and applicable states are processed on schedule with at least 99?curacy.

* Payroll, bank, general ledger, benefit, 401(k), tax, and funding reconciliations are reviewed by deadline, with variances resolved and documented.

* Multi-state registrations, payroll tax filings and payments, garnishments, and other compliance requirements are completed on time without avoidable penalties.

* Paycom configurations, workflows, permissions, controls, employee data, and audit trails are maintained, tested, documented, and secure.

* Payroll service levels are met, employee inquiries are acknowledged within one business day, and errors are corrected and communicated promptly.

* Monthly payroll scorecards and quarterly improvement plans demonstrate progress in automation, efficiency, control quality, scalability, and accuracy.

* Upon achieving these key performance indicators, your supervisor will meet with you to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth and excellence.



Core Competencies

* Demonstrate advanced knowledge of end-to-end multi-state and multi-entity payroll, payroll accounting, benefits, 401(k), taxes, garnishments, and compliance.

* Demonstrate hands-on leadership, ownership, sound judgment, organization, and follow-through across 10 companies and recurring deadlines.

* Demonstrate advanced Paycom capability, strong Excel skills, data discipline, control awareness, and commitment to process automation.

title: Artwork Reviewer QC
description:
ABOUT DROOL

DROOL is a curated art print brand working with emerging and established artists. Every piece we sell has to hold up in print, from small gallery-wall prints right up to extra large statement pieces. This role exists to protect that quality bar.

The role



You'll be the person who reviews artwork files as artists submit them, checks whether they meet our print standards, and d
 the largest size we can confidently sell each piece at. The bigger the size range we can offer, the more customers we capture, so a big part of the job is pushing every artwork to the largest size it can hold without the quality dropping off. It isn't a heavily technical role, but it is a nuanced one. A good eye and a solid grasp of print quality matter more than anything else.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Review incoming artwork files, mostly digital work (vector, digital painting, Procreate, Illustrator and Photoshop files) as well as scanned originals.





Check each file against our core print ratios (A-series such as A0, plus 4:5 and 2:3) and the pixel dimensions we need at 300 DPI.





Soft-proof every file in Photoshop: rulers set to inches, zoom in to 100 to 120 percent, and inspect for crisp lines, clean edges, and no pixelation, blur, or low-resolution textures laid over otherwise clean artwork.





D
 the maximum size each piece can launch at, from small through to extra large, always aiming for the widest range possible.





Flag issues clearly back to the artist, request higher-resolution versions where needed, and re-check resubmissions.





Set up and launch approved artworks at the correct sizes.





Keep quality consistent across a steady weekly volume, with larger batches around collection launches.

What we're looking for

A strong understanding of graphic design and print production: resolution, DPI, print ratios, and the difference between vector and raster work.





Confident in Photoshop, checking image size, soft-proofing, and reading resolution. Familiarity with Illustrator and Procreate files is a plus.





A sharp eye for detail. You can spot pixelation, blur, or a low-res texture at a glance.





Fluent written English, since you'll be giving clear feedback directly to artists.





Reliable and self-managing. Comfortable taking feedback and iterating while you get to grips with our standards, then running with it independently.

title: INSURANCE GAP EXCEPTION SPECIALIST | P12,480/week |P49,920/month | Weekly Pay
description:
INSURANCE GAP EXCEPTION SPECIALIST

Contract | Remote (Philippines)

Rate: P12,480/week (~$240 USD/week) | P49,900/month

Weekly pay via Wise

Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday – Friday

 - This is a dedicated contract role for two to eight weeks. You may not work other projects or clients during scheduled hours.  - We typically observe all Philippine regular holidays as paid days off, but given the urgency of this engagement we may need full availability for the during the contract period. 

 - If the role converts to permanent, 13th month would be paid (prorated first year) and all Philippine regular holidays would be paid days off. 



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Atlanta Lactation is a high-volume U.S. lactation practice — 17 clinicians, 12+ locations, hundreds of patients per month. For years, our patients received excellent insurance coverage for lactation care through their Anthem/BCBS plans. That changed recently when BCBS stopped paying our claims. Families who counted on that coverage are now scrambling, and we are working urgently to restore their access through network gap exceptions. 

 - This role is focused on one thing: securing network gap exceptions so our patients can access covered care and our claims can be paid. If you know how to work the phones with payer provider relations, document exception requests correctly, follow up relentlessly, and get approvals — this role was built for you.

 - This is a contract engagement. The timeline depends entirely on payer behavior — if Anthem/BCBS honors gap exception approvals with actual reimbursement, this role extends to at least six months,  and has a clear path to a permanent billing position focused on denials and appeals. 

 - If they don't pay, the engagement ends once we identify payment patterns. We are transparent about that upfront.



WHY THIS ROLE

 - This is a small, tight team. You will not be one of hundreds of billers working a queue for a faceless RCM company. You will know the practice, know the patients, and talk directly to the people making decisions. When something is broken, you fix it and move on — no bureaucracy, no layers.

 - Our Filipino tea
mbers stay. Some are approaching six years with us. That is not an a
. We invest in the people who show up for us, and we do not let good people go when we can find a reason to keep them. If this engagement converts, you will know it early and we will make it official.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Work gap exception requests end to end. Identify patients where a gap exception applies, initiate requests with payer provider relations, document everything, and follow up until you have an answer.

 - Own payer provider relations calls. You will be on the phone with Anthem, BCBS, and other commercial payers regularly. You need to know how to navigate these calls, who to escalate to, and how to get results.

 - Track and report outcomes. We need to know quickly whether exceptions are paying. You will maintain clear records of requests submitted, approvals received, denials, and reimbursement received so we can make decisions fast.

 - Coordinate with our billing team. Once exceptions are approved, you will hand off cleanly so claims move through without delay.

 - Identify patterns. If certain payers, plan types, or request approaches are working better than others, we want to know. You will flag what you're seeing.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Direct experience working network gap exceptions with U.S. commercial payers. This is not a role for someone who has read about it — we need someone who has done it.

 - Familiarity with Anthem and BCBS specifically, including their provider relations processes.

 - Strong phone skills. You will spend significant time on hold and on calls with payer representatives. Persistence and professionalism are non-negotiable.

 - Clear, organized documentation habits. Every request, every call, every outcome needs to be tracked.

 - Strong written and spoken English.

 - Self-directed. This engagement has a short runway if results don't come. You need to hit the ground running.

 - Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office.



PREFERRED

 - Experience with lactation, women's health, or preventive care billing — payers treat these differently and familiarity helps.

 - Experience with Spruce, IntakeQ, Availity, Office Ally or TriZetto.

 - Background in denials and appeals (relevant if this role converts).



ABOUT THE CONVERSION PATH

We are transparent about what this engagement is. Whether it extends depends on payer reimbursement behavior, not your performance. If claims pay, this role grows into a permanent billing position focused on denials and appeals — and we don't cycle through contractors. When we find someone good, we find a way to keep them. If payers don't cooperate, we'll say so clearly and part on good terms.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply by messaging us through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



Subject line must read: GAP EXCEPTION – [Your Name]

Your updated resume.

A 1–2 minute voice or video introduction covering: your specific experience working network gap exceptions, the payers you've worked with, and why you're looking for a new role.

 campaign requirements

Schedule

Deadlines

Responsibilities

Launch plan

They should not wait for you to prescribe every individual post.

You provide the higher-level diagnosis and direction. They build and execute the campaign around it.



4. Process building

This should be an explicit part of the role—not something you hope they do eventually.

They should build and continuously improve:

Client onboarding workflow

Brand immersion process

Campaign planning template

Content calendar system

Creative briefing template

Static ad production workflow

Video editing workflow

Approval process

Content scheduling process

Shoot planning system

Asset naming and file storage

Weekly client review process

Performance-to-creative feedback loop

Client offboarding or handover process

Each time they complete a task, they should ask:

“How do we turn this into a system that someone else can follow?”

That is how the role evolves from doing everything themselves into eventually managing a larger creative team.



5. Content operations

They should own the full flow from idea to publication:

Strategy ? concept ? brief ? production ? review ? approval ? scheduling ? performance review

That includes:

Ensuring content is planned ahead

Briefing editors

Briefing creators

Creating static assets

Reviewing initial edits

Managing client approvals

Maintaining content reserves

Scheduling approved content

Flagging missing assets

Reporting what performed

Updating future creative based on results

They own whether content is ready—not merely whether they sent someone a message about it.



6. Client activation

This is especially important for solving your current bottleneck.

Once you close a new client, the Marketing Manager should be capable of moving them through:

Onboarding

Access collection

Brand immersion

Existing asset review

Campaign priorities

Visual direction

Content plan

Creative briefs

Production

Approval

Scheduling

Active campaign delivery

You should still lead strategic workshops and major commercial decisions, but the Marketing Manager should drive the client from signed to operational.



What the role is not



The main Meta buyer

A full-time video editor

A website developer

A customer service assistant

A project manager who produces nothing

A social media scheduler waiting for instructions

A junior designer who cannot make campaign decisions

They need to combine creative judgement, hands-on production and operational ownership.



The ideal candidate profile

You are looking for someone who is:

Creatively led

Commercially aware

Strong at static design

Extremely organised

Capable of building systems

Comfortable taking ownership

Able to give clear feedback to editors

Interested in brands, campaigns and consumer psychology

Fast without becoming careless

Able to move between fashion, health, beauty, travel and other clients

Confident enough to challenge weak creative

Resourceful enough to solve problems without waiting for you



Their portfolio should show more than attractive posts.

You want evidence that they can create:

Cohesive brand worlds

Campaign concepts

Conversion-focused statics

Social media systems

Clear visual direction

Commercially relevant creative

description:
# Executive Virtual Assistant to the CEO



**Full-Time | Pacific Time Schedule | $8–$10 USD per Hour**



## About the Company



Option One Solar is a growing solar, roofing, construction, technology, and eCommerce organization based in California. We are building scalable systems, launching new business divisions, implementing AI and automation, and expanding our operations.



We are hiring an experienced **Executive Virtual Assistant to directly support the CEO**.



This is not a basic administrative assistant position. We need someone who can help manage executive priorities, coordinate projects, build systems, implement automations, manage digital platforms, and turn ideas into completed projects.



The ideal candidate has previously supported the CEO, founder, or senior executive of a company with **100 or more employees** and is comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.



## Compensation and Schedule



* $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience

* Full-time position

* Must be available during Pacific Time business hours

* Long-term opportunity

* Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance

s, documents, and communications

mbers to ensure projects are completed

* Connect software platforms through APIs, webhooks, and no-code automation tools

### Website and Digital Systems

s, and website content

* Help manage order workflows, customer notifications, shipping integrations, and fulfillment

* Assist with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms

* Research products, suppliers, competitors, and market opportunities

* Help build documented and scalable eCommerce processes



## Required Experience



You must have:



* Previous experience directly supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive

* Experience supporting an executive at a company with at least 100 employees

* Strong project management experience

* Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

* AI and business automation experience

* Experience with ChatGPT and Claude

* Experience with Zapier, n8n, Make, or similar automation platforms

* Website design or website management experience

* Social media management experience

* eCommerce experience

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills

* Advanced Google Workspace experience

* The ability to work independently during Pacific Time business hours

## Preferred Experience

mbers and hold projects accountable

title: Static Ad Designer (Shopify / E-commerce)
description:
Static Ad Designer

(E-commerce / DR Marketing) Fully Remote

Schedule: Flexible (set your own hours)

Employment: Type Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary, paid in USD



Company Overview

- We operate multiple successful e-commerce brands in the skincare and health & wellness sectors, consistently achieving 7-figure monthly revenues. Our brands are heavily focused on direct response marketing, creative testing, and funnel optimization. We are scaling aggressively toward 9-figure annual revenue.



Why Join Us?

- Design statics that run against real budget on 8-figure DTC brands; every week, not every quarter.

- Bridge the gap between classic direct response design and cutting-edge AI production.

- Full ownership of the static pipeline, from concept to high-velocity testing.

- Work with a highly ambitious team and the resources to test 50+ creatives weekly.



Role Summary

- As a Static Ad Designer, you will own the image side of our Meta creative engine. Your primary focus is producing high-converting static ads at volume; concepts, hooks, layouts and variations that get tested immediately and judged on numbers.

- You must have a deep understanding of Direct Response (DR) principles. We are not looking for beautiful graphics; we are looking for graphics that win in the auction. You will work closely with the Creative Strategy, Media Buying and Growth teams, turning performance data into the next batch of winning visual concepts, and killing the ones that don't earn their spend.



Key Responsibilities

- Produce high-volume static ad creative for Meta across multiple brands and niches.

- Build systematic variations: hooks, headlines, layouts, social proof, comparison charts, before/afters, UGC-style statics, native-looking placements.

- Turn winning video angles into statics, and winning statics into new angles for video.

- Adapt creative for Shopify landing pages and PDPs so the ad-to-page experience doesn't break.

- Use AI tools to compress production time: generate, retouch, extend, upscale and localize at speed.

- Analyze KPIs (CTR, hook rate, CPA, ROAS) to refine creative direction in real-time.



Requirements (Must-Have)

- Proven DR Background: Extensive experience designing static ads for direct response e-commerce.

- High-Volume Output: Experience shipping dozens of static iterations weekly without quality collapse.

- Portfolio: A proven track record of winning statics tied to real performance data, not a brand book.

- Tooling: Advanced Photoshop; Figma and Illustrator at working level.

- English: Solid written and spoken English, with meaningful CET overlap.



Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Experience in the US market (specifically 40+ female audience).

- DTC experience, ideally in skincare, health, or wellness niches.

- Background in direct response copywriting, you can write your own headline.

- Motion or video editing ability for quick statics-to-video adaptations.

- Hands-on experience inside the Shopify and Meta Ads ecosystem, and an understanding of how the two connect.

- Deep hands-on AI experience.



Ideal Candidate Profile

- Performance Obsessed: You care more about CTR and CVR than winning design awards.

- Versatile: You can write a hook, mock a landing section, or cut a rough video if the team needs a hand.

- Fast & Agile: You'd rather test 20 concepts this month than perfect 3.

- The "AI Architect": You use AI tools to optimize workflows, create variations, and test new visual styles.





To Apply: 

You must answer all the questions below. 

1. Please send us your updated Linkedn/Upwork profile or CV with google drive link (make sure that it's visible to everyone)

2. Please share a portfolio link showcasing static ads you designed for DTC e-commerce brands. Where possible, include performance context (CTR, ROAS, or "this ad spent $X")

3. This role requires shipping a high volume of static iterations weekly. Realistically, how many finished static ad variations can you produce per week without sacrificing quality?

4. Which AI tools do you currently use in your static ad production workflow (e.g., generation, retouching, upscaling)? And how do they impact your production speed/quality? Please explain briefly

5.Choose the areas you have experience with. In your answer, list the letters that apply to you (e.g., "A, C, E, G").

A. High-Volume Static Production

B. Photo Retouching & Product Compositing (Photoshop)

C. Design Systems & Templating (Figma components for scaled variation)

D. Direct Response Ad Design (Hooks, offers, headline hierarchy)

E. Advertorial & Native Statics (Editorial, listicle, "news" formats)

title: Senior AI Graphic Designer - Realistic AI Ads (Higgsfield, NanoBanana, Claude) - Long-Term
description:
WHO WE ARE



RoofIgnite runs Meta advertising systems for roofing and HVAC contractors doing serious volume. Every ad we run needs a creative behind it, and that creative has to look real. Not stock-photo real, not obviously-AI real. Real enough that a homeowner scrolling their feed believes it's their neighbor's roof getting done.



We run hundreds to thousands of ads at a time across clients. That means we need a constant supply of new creative that doesn't look recycled, doesn't look fake, and doesn't get flagged by the platform or ignored by the scroll.



That's where you come in.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Bad creative doesn't just underperform, it costs our clients money and it costs us the account. Good creative is the difference between a $40 cost-per-lead and a $15 cost-per-lead. You're not making pretty pictures. You're making the thing that d
 whether a homeowner stops scrolling or keeps going.



We're handing you real reference material and real client accounts. What you produce goes straight into live ad campaigns spending real client budget. If it looks fake, we feel it immediately in the numbers, and so does the client.



This is a long-term seat. We're not looking for someone to test the waters for a few weeks. We want someone who gets better at this every month for the next year and beyond, and who wants to grow with the company as our creative demand scales.



This is an urgent hire. We want someone starting immediately.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



CORE (this is the heart of the job):



AI Image Generation

Take existing reference images and turn them into new, branded ad creatives. That means:

- Swapping faces

- Replacing logos and company branding

- Adding realistic people (sales reps, technicians, homeowners)

- Adding realistic local environments (houses, streets, trash bins, vehicles, etc.)

No distorted faces, no extra fingers, no obvious AI tells. If it looks fake, it doesn't ship.



Video Creation & Editing

Create short AI-generated videos when a campaign calls for it, and edit both AI and non-AI footage into a polished final cut that's ready for paid placement.



Creative Iteration

Follow feedback fast and precisely. You'll get notes on what's not converting or what looks off, and you'll turn those into the next version same day, not next week. Speed matters here as much as quality.



SECONDARY (steady, but not the main event):



Photo Editing

Basic cleanup and polish work in Photoshop or Canva, touching up AI output so it holds up under close inspection.



Organization

Keep creative assets, versions, and client folders organized so nothing gets mixed up across accounts. When you're producing at volume, a messy system costs everyone time.



THE PART MOST PEOPLE GET WRONG:



This role needs two things that rarely live in the same person: real AI tool fluency AND a sharp eye for what actually looks fake. Most applicants have one. The tool-fluent people generate fast but don't catch the extra finger or the warped doorframe. The detail-oriented people catch every flaw but can't produce fast enough to keep up with hundreds of ads running at once. We need both in one person. If you're missing either, this isn't your role, and that's okay.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real, hands-on experience with AI image generation tools (NanoBanana, Higgsfield AI, ChatGPT, Sora, Kling, or similar). Not "I've played around with it."

- Ability to make AI output look realistic under scrutiny, no distorted faces, hands, or artifacts

- Fast turnaround on feedback and revisions

- Basic photo editing skills (Photoshop or Canva a plus)

- Fluent English, written and spoken

- Able to work full-time, Eastern Time Zone hours, 40 hrs/week



BONUS



Experience running Meta ads. If you understand the ad account side, you'll know why certain creative gets approved and certain creative gets suppressed, and you'll build for that from the start.



PAY AND BONUSES



Starting salary is $900 USD/month. On top of that, you earn performance incentives tied to how your creatives actually perform in the ad accounts. Creative that drives bookings at a lower or equal cost than what's already running gets rewarded. Do the work well and you make more. We run hundreds to thousands of ads at a time, so there's real room to grow your output and your pay here.



THE SCREENING TEST (REQUIRED)



Before you apply, generate 2 to 3 sample images that include all three of the following in one image: a person, branding, and a real environment.



Completing this is required, not optional.



To apply, start your application with the word CREATIVE so we know you read this whole post.



Any application that skips the sample images, skips the CREATIVE keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a hard gate.



HOW TO APPLY



A recording is mandatory. Submit either a Loom video (strongly preferred) or a Vocaroo voice recording (
).



In your recording, cover:

1. Your name and location.

2. What AI tools you use and how you make your images look realistic for ads.

3. What sets you apart from other candidates when we consider bringing you on the team.



Applicants who submit sample images correctly and include a recording are the only ones we'll consider for an interview. No recording, no interview.



The recording is also how we screen English fluency and personality for a role where you'll get fast, direct feedback constantly, so speak clearly and naturally. Be yourself.

title: Up to $2000/MO Creative Operations Coordinator
description:
Creative Operations Coordinator



Growing Pains Marketing



Compensation



$1,000–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, communication ability, AI fluency, DTC eCommerce agency background, and ability to keep creative production moving independently.



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on helping DTC eCommerce brands scale through paid social advertising, primarily on Meta.



We work with fast-moving brands in competitive and compliance-sensitive categories, including wellness, CBD-adjacent, research compounds, alternative products, and other restricted markets.



Our creative process moves quickly. We produce ads, test angles, review performance, revise assets, coordinate UGC creators, and launch new creative every week.



We are looking for a highly organized Creative Operations Coordinator who has already worked inside a DTC eCommerce marketing agency and understands how fast creative production moves.



This person must also use AI tools daily to work faster, organize better, summarize information, create checklists, clean up tasks, improve communication, and help keep the creative team moving.



Role Overview



We are hiring a Creative Operations Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day creative production workflow.



This is not a traditional project manager role. This is a hands-on coordination role for someone who can use Asana, Slack, Google Drive, Notion/Sheets, and AI to make sure creative tasks are clear, updated, assigned, followed up on, and completed on time.



You will coordinate between creative strategists, designers, video editors, UGC coordinators, creator sourcers, and media buyers.



Your job is to make sure creative does not get stuck.



You will help answer:



What is being worked on?

Who owns it?

When is it due?

What is blocked?

What needs review?

What needs revision?

What is ready to launch?

Which UGC creators are waiting on outreach, shipment, filming, footage, or revisions?



Your main responsibility is to keep the creative production machine organized and moving.



Must-Have Requirements



You must have:



Previous experience working in a DTC eCommerce marketing agency.

Experience coordinating creative production for paid social ads.

Daily experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Notion AI, or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Meta ad creative workflows.

Experience working with designers, video editors, UGC creators, creative strategists, and/or media buyers.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong organization and follow-up ability.

Strong attention to detail.

Comfort working in a fast-paced remote agency environment.

Ability to submit a clear Loom video that is 5 minutes or less.



Please do not apply if you have only worked in general admin, local service businesses, corporate project management, or non-eCommerce roles. We need someone who understands DTC eCommerce creative production.



AI Requirement



AI usage is a daily part of this role.



You should already be using AI to:



Summarize Slack threads.

Turn messy notes into clean Asana tasks.

Create checklists.

Draft follow-up messages.

Organize revision notes.

Identify missing information in briefs.

Create daily status updates.

Summarize blockers.

Improve task descriptions.

Build simple trackers.

Prepare weekly creative production summaries.

Improve communication speed and clarity.



You do not need to be an AI developer, but you must be comfortable using AI every day to work faster, think clearer, and keep projects organized.



A candidate who does not use AI daily is not a fit for this role.



What You’ll Own



You will help manage the workflow from creative request to final delivery.



This includes:



Making sure every creative task has a clear brief.

Making sure required assets are attached.

Confirming task owners and due dates.

Keeping Asana updated.

Following up with designers, video editors, UGC coordinators, and creative strategists.

Tracking what is in progress, blocked, waiting for review, needing revision, approved, or ready to launch.

Making sure revisions are tracked and completed.

Escalating blockers before they become major delays.

Making sure creative is submitted for internal review before client review or launch.

Helping the team stay focused on the highest-priority creative work.

Using AI to improve task clarity, summarize updates, and prevent missing details.

Core Responsibilities

1. Creative Production Coordination



You will coordinate the day-to-day creative workflow across multiple DTC eCommerce clients and projects.



Responsibilities include:



Review new creative tasks and confirm they are complete.

Make sure each task includes the script, brief, assets, product details, offer, CTA, brand notes, examples, and deadline.

Confirm who owns each task.

Track daily progress across design, video, AI video, and UGC projects.

Make sure tasks move through the correct stages.

Follow up when a task is stuck.

Make sure deadlines are visible.

Keep the team updated on priorities.

Maintain a clean production calendar or task board.

Help prevent missed deadlines, lost feedback, or unclear ownership.

2. Asana / Task Management



You will help keep Asana clean and accurate.



Responsibilities include:



Create or update creative tasks.

Add owners, due dates, priorities, descriptions, links, and assets.

Use AI to turn messy briefs, Slack threads, or notes into clear Asana tasks.

Make sure task statuses reflect reality.

Move tasks through the correct workflow stages.

Add comments and updates when progress changes.

Track blockers and dependencies.

Tag the correct people when action is needed.

Make sure completed tasks are only closed after final approval or delivery.

Make sure no task sits untouched without explanation.



The goal is that anyone on the team should be able to look at Asana and immediately understand what is happening.



3. Creative Team Follow-Up



You will coordinate with the creative team to make sure everyone knows what they need to do.



You will work with:



Creative Strategists.

Designers.

Video Editors.

AI Video Editors.

UGC Coordinators.

UGC Creator Sourcers.

Media Buyers.

COO / Leadership.



Responsibilities include:



Clarify task requirements.

Confirm priorities.

Follow up on progress.

Ask for updates before deadlines are missed.

Make sure feedback gets to the correct person.

Help resolve confusion between tea
mbers.

Escalate issues to leadership when needed.

Keep communication clear, professional, and direct.

Use AI to clean up unclear communication, summarize feedback, and turn conversations into action items.

4. UGC Production Coordination



You will help manage the UGC creator workflow.



You do not need to personally source every creator from scratch, but you are responsible for making sure the UGC process is organized and moving.



Responsibilities include:



Confirm when a script requires a UGC creator.

Make sure creator requirements are clear.

Track creator selection status.

Confirm outreach has been sent.

Track whether creators accepted, declined, or need follow-up.

Make sure shipping information is collected.

Coordinate with the team for product shipment.

Track product shipment status.

Track creator filming deadlines after product delivery.

Follow up on raw footage submissions.

Make sure raw footage is reviewed.

Track revision requests.

Make sure approved footage is handed off to the video editor.

Update Asana or the UGC tracker throughout the process.

Escalate creator delays, missing footage, shipping issues, or revision problems.

5. Revision and Feedback Tracking



You will make sure revisions are tracked clearly and completed correctly.



Responsibilities include:



Collect revision notes from leadership, creative strategists, clients, or media buyers.

Use AI to organize messy revision notes into clear action items.

Make sure feedback is clear and actionable.

Assign revisions to the correct tea
mber.

Track revision deadlines.

Confirm revised assets are submitted.

Make sure old feedback does not get lost.

Make sure the final version matches the requested changes.

Prevent duplicate, conflicting, or outdated feedback from creating confusion.

6. Creative QA Support



You are not expected to be the final creative approver, but you should help catch basic issues before assets move forward.



You should look for:



Missing assets.

Wrong product.

Wrong offer.

Wrong CTA.

Missing script.

Missing captions.

Incorrect dimensions.

Obvious spelling or grammar errors.

Text that is cut off.

Poor file naming.

Missing links.

Tasks submitted without all required deliverables.

Creative that has not followed the brief.



Over time, this role may grow into more formal creative QA support.

title: Hiring Senior DTC eCommerce Video Editor
description:
Senior DTC eCommerce Video Editor



Remote | Full-Time | UGC, AI Video & Motion Graphics | Meta Ads



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency that helps DTC eCommerce brands scale through paid social, creative strategy, and direct-response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and frequently work with brands in competitive and compliance-sensitive categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD and THC-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other restricted markets.



We are hiring a highly skilled video editor who can turn scripts, creative briefs, raw footage, product assets, and AI-generated content into polished advertisements designed to drive purchases.



This is not a basic clip-cutting position.



We need an editor who understands why an advertisement works, how to capture attention within the first three seconds, how to maintain viewer interest, and how to make AI-generated content look and sound believable.



What You Will Create



You will produce short-form advertisements for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.



Your work may include:



Direct-response video ads

Authentic UGC-style ads

AI spokesperson and talking-head videos

AI-generated B-roll

Product demonstrations

Testimonials and review-style ads

Listicles and comparison ads

Motion-graphics ads

New hooks and creative variations



You will work across multiple DTC eCommerce brands with different products, audiences, offers, and visual identities.



You will collaborate with creative strategists, media buyers, designers, UGC creators, and agency leadership.



Core Responsibilities



Direct-Response Editing

Turn scripts and creative briefs into clear, persuasive advertisements.

Create hooks that capture attention within the first one to three seconds.

Structure videos around customer problems, desires, objections, benefits, proof, offers, and calls to action.

Use pacing, captions, B-roll, visual changes, pattern interrupts, sound design, and motion graphics to maintain attention.

Create meaningful variations instead of only changing fonts, colors, or music.

Edit for purchases and conversions, not views alone.



UGC Editing

Turn raw creator footage into authentic, natural-looking advertisements.

Remove pauses, mistakes, weak lines, and unnecessary sections without making the creator sound unnatural.

Improve footage with slow delivery, poor framing, limited B-roll, or inconsistent audio.

Add relevant product footage, screenshots, reviews, visual proof, captions, and graphics.

Understand when UGC should feel polished and when it should remain casual or imperfect.



AI Video Production

Create believable AI spokesperson and presenter videos.

Generate visually consistent AI B-roll that supports the script.

Create AI voices that sound natural, conversational, and emotionally appropriate.

Correct unnatural pacing, pauses, pronunciation, emphasis, and delivery.

Identify and fix visible AI issues involving lip movement, faces, hands, objects, backgrounds, and scene consistency.

Maintain consistency between generated characters, products, environments, and branding.



Motion Graphics, Captions and Sound Design

Create motion graphics that improve clarity and retention.

Animate hooks, benefits, reviews, offers, statistics, and calls to action.

Create readable, mobile-first captions with a clear visual hierarchy.

Follow each brand’s fonts, colors, and design standards.

Clean and balance dialogue audio.

Mix voice, music, and sound effects appropriately.

Use transitions and effects intentionally without creating unnecessary visual clutter.

Brand and Compliance Accuracy

Follow creative briefs and brand guidelines precisely.

Use approved logos, packaging, product images, fonts, colors, and claims.

Avoid introducing unapproved medical, health, financial, performance, or product claims.

Flag potential compliance concerns before submitting creative.

Check every video for spelling, grammar, punctuation, product accuracy, and safe-area placement.

Ensure the advertisement matches the product, offer, and landing page.



Agency Workflow

Manage projects across multiple client accounts and deadlines.

Follow naming conventions, folder structures, and project-management processes.

Maintain organized project files that another editor can easily open and revise.

Submit editable source files with completed work.

Communicate blockers and deadline risks before they become problems.

Complete revisions quickly without repeating previous mistakes.

Provide clear beginning-of-day and end-of-day updates.

Record Loom videos when needed to explain your work or creative decisions.



Required Experience



You must have:



Professional video-editing experience.

Experience creating direct-response ads for DTC eCommerce brands.

Experience editing authentic UGC advertisements.

Experience with AI video, AI voices, AI spokespeople, or AI-generated B-roll.

Strong knowledge of pacing, storytelling, captions, sound design, color correction, motion graphics, and visual hierarchy.

A strong understanding of Meta ads and short-form paid social creative.

The ability to turn a script and basic asset package into a complete advertisement.

The ability to make AI-generated content look and sound human.

The ability to work across multiple brands without making every video look the same.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong communication, organization, and deadline management.

Comfort receiving direct feedback and completing revisions.

Comfort working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.

The ability to provide editable project files and organized source assets.



Editing Software



You must be highly proficient with at least one professional editing workflow, such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro



CapCut may be part of your workflow, but CapCut experience alone does not qualify someone as a senior editor.



Your submitted work must demonstrate professional editing fundamentals, direct-response judgment, motion skills, and agency-level execution.



Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:



Photoshop

Illustrator

Runway

Kling

Veo

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

ChatGPT

Midjourney



Google Drive

Slack

Asana

Motion

Foreplay

Meta Ad Library

TikTok Creative Center

Nice to Have

Previous DTC eCommerce agency experience.

Experience with wellness, supplements, CBD, telemedicine, research compounds, or other restricted categories.

Experience reviewing creative-performance data.

Experience creating multiple hooks from one core concept.

Experience working directly with UGC creators.

Experience writing or improving UGC scripts.

Experience building reusable editing systems and templates.

Experience reviewing or managing junior editors.

AI prompt-engineering experience.

Graphic-design, product-photography, or creative-strategy experience.

Schedule and Availability



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours, generally within the following windows:



6:00–9:00 AM Eastern Time

3:00–5:00 PM Eastern Time



Your exact schedule may depend on your assigned shift.



Compensation



$1,500–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, skill level, speed, communication, and quality of work.



Higher compensation may be considered for candidates who can:



Consistently produce senior-level creative.

Create advanced custom motion graphics.

Lead AI video production.

Review and improve the work of other editors.

Build editing systems and quality-control processes.

Operate with minimal supervision.

How to Apply

Applications Are Accepted by
 Only



Do not message us through OnlineJobs.ph.



Send your complete application to:







Use the subject line:



Senior Video Editor Application – Your Full Name



Everything must be included in one
.



Your application
 must contain:



Written answers to all application questions below

The exact requested work examples

A Loom video recorded specifically for this position

Your desired monthly compensation

Your availability in Eastern Time



Applications missing the written answers, requested examples, or position-specific Loom video will not be reviewed.



Generic, copy-and-paste, or fully AI-generated applications that do not specifically explain your actual experience will not be considered.



Application Questions

.



1. Experience

9. Compensation and Fit

Required Work Examples

Do Not Send Your Full Portfolio

Only provide the exact examples requested below:

Video editing

description:
Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist



We're an established meta ads marketing agency looking for a high-volume Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist who can create direct-response static ad creatives for paid social campaigns.



This is not a slow branding role. This is a fast-paced, production-based creative role for someone who can move quickly, follow briefs, use AI tools, and produce a high volume of clean, usable ad creatives every day.



We work with fast-growing brands and move quickly as a team. We care deeply about client results, clear communication, strong execution, and high standards. We want someone who takes ownership of their work, stays organized, communicates proactively, and does not wait to be told what to do when something is unclear or needs to be fixed.



You will be responsible for producing 100 static ad creatives per day, Monday through Friday, using assigned briefs, templates, hooks, offers, client assets, and creative direction.



We use Asana for project management and Slack for daily team communication.



What You’ll Do



In this role, you will create high-volume static ad creatives for
 and Instagram campaigns. Your work will be used for direct-response testing, so the goal is not just to make things look good. The goal is to create clean, readable, launch-ready ads that clearly communicate the hook, offer, and message.



You will be expected to:



•Create 100 static ad creatives per day.



•Design
 and Instagram static ads.



•Use AI tools to speed up creative production.



•Follow assigned creative briefs inside Asana.



•Create variations of hooks, headlines, offers, layouts, and visual concepts.



•Organize files by client, campaign, date, and angle.



•Communicate daily progress, blockers, and completed work in Slack.



•Make revisions quickly based on feedback.



•Maintain a high standard of usable, launch-ready creative.



•Work collaboratively with creative strategists, media buyers, and account managers.



•Pay attention to what is being tested and why, so creative output improves over time.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is fast, organized, creative, coachable, and comfortable with high-volume production.



You do not need to be the world’s fanciest designer. You do need to be reliable, detail-oriented, and able to create ads that are clear enough to test. You should understand that paid social creative needs to sell, not just look pretty.



You should have experience with:



Area

Design tools

AI creative tools

 and Instagram static ad creatives.

Workflow tools

High-volume production

Strong English communication is important because this role requires clear written updates, feedback loops, and daily coordination with the team.



Key Metrics



This role is measured by simple production and quality numbers. We care about speed, but we also care about accuracy, organization, and whether the creative is actually usable.





Daily production volume

100 statics per day

You are expected to produce 100 completed static ad creatives per workday, Monday through Friday.



Weekly output

500 statics per week

QA pass rate

90%+

At least 90% of submitted creatives should pass our internal QA scorecard.



QA includes things like correct offer, correct client or brand, correct dimensions, clear visual hierarchy, no spelling errors, proper file naming, organized folders, and whether the creative follows the assigned brief.



What We Care About Most



We want someone who takes ownership.



If something is unclear, you ask. If something breaks, you communicate. If a brief is missing something important, you flag it instead of guessing silently. If feedback is given, you apply it quickly and improve the next batch.



We move fast, expect high standards, and care deeply about client results. The right person for this role is calm under pressure, organized in their workflow, and able to keep producing without letting quality fall apart.



This role is a good fit for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable being measured by output. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of the creative production system, not someone who needs constant reminders or hand-holding.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You



•Like fast-paced creative production.



•Are comfortable using AI tools.



•Can follow directions without needing constant reminders.



•Understand that ads need to sell, not just look pretty.



•Can create lots of variations quickly.

•Need several hours to make one design.



•Dislike AI tools.



•Struggle with organization.



•Do not like being measured by output.



•Disappear during work hours.



•Get defensive about feedback.



•Cannot consistently follow briefs.



•Need constant reminders to complete assigned work.



•Are uncomfortable with fast-paced agency-style work.

This is a full-time role.





Schedule

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, New York City time



Location

How To Apply

title: AI Creative Specialist Needed - $900+/month + Performance Bonuses (Long-Term Position)
description:
WHO WE ARE



RoofIgnite runs Meta advertising systems for roofing and HVAC contractors doing serious volume. Every ad we run needs a creative behind it, and that creative has to look real. Not stock-photo real, not obviously-AI real. Real enough that a homeowner scrolling their feed believes it's their neighbor's roof getting done.



We run hundreds to thousands of ads at a time across clients. That means we need a constant supply of new creative that doesn't look recycled, doesn't look fake, and doesn't get flagged by the platform or ignored by the scroll.



That's where you come in.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Bad creative doesn't just underperform, it costs our clients money and it costs us the account. Good creative is the difference between a $40 cost-per-lead and a $15 cost-per-lead. You're not making pretty pictures. You're making the thing that d
 whether a homeowner stops scrolling or keeps going.



We're handing you real reference material and real client accounts. What you produce goes straight into live ad campaigns spending real client budget. If it looks fake, we feel it immediately in the numbers, and so does the client.



This is a long-term seat. We're not looking for someone to test the waters for a few weeks. We want someone who gets better at this every month for the next year and beyond, and who wants to grow with the company as our creative demand scales.



This is an urgent hire. We want someone starting immediately.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



CORE (this is the heart of the job):



AI Image Generation

Take existing reference images and turn them into new, branded ad creatives. That means:

- Swapping faces

- Replacing logos and company branding

- Adding realistic people (sales reps, technicians, homeowners)

- Adding realistic local environments (houses, streets, trash bins, vehicles, etc.)

No distorted faces, no extra fingers, no obvious AI tells. If it looks fake, it doesn't ship.



Video Creation & Editing

Create short AI-generated videos when a campaign calls for it, and edit both AI and non-AI footage into a polished final cut that's ready for paid placement.



Creative Iteration

Follow feedback fast and precisely. You'll get notes on what's not converting or what looks off, and you'll turn those into the next version same day, not next week. Speed matters here as much as quality.



SECONDARY (steady, but not the main event):



Photo Editing

Basic cleanup and polish work in Photoshop or Canva, touching up AI output so it holds up under close inspection.



Organization

Keep creative assets, versions, and client folders organized so nothing gets mixed up across accounts. When you're producing at volume, a messy system costs everyone time.



THE PART MOST PEOPLE GET WRONG:



This role needs two things that rarely live in the same person: real AI tool fluency AND a sharp eye for what actually looks fake. Most applicants have one. The tool-fluent people generate fast but don't catch the extra finger or the warped doorframe. The detail-oriented people catch every flaw but can't produce fast enough to keep up with hundreds of ads running at once. We need both in one person. If you're missing either, this isn't your role, and that's okay.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real, hands-on experience with AI image generation tools (NanoBanana, Higgsfield AI, ChatGPT, Sora, Kling, or similar). Not "I've played around with it."

- Ability to make AI output look realistic under scrutiny, no distorted faces, hands, or artifacts

- Fast turnaround on feedback and revisions

- Basic photo editing skills (Photoshop or Canva a plus)

- Fluent English, written and spoken

- Able to work full-time, Eastern Time Zone hours, 40 hrs/week



BONUS



Experience running Meta ads. If you understand the ad account side, you'll know why certain creative gets approved and certain creative gets suppressed, and you'll build for that from the start.



PAY AND BONUSES



Starting salary is $900 USD/month. On top of that, you earn performance incentives tied to how your creatives actually perform in the ad accounts. Creative that drives bookings at a lower or equal cost than what's already running gets rewarded. Do the work well and you make more. We run hundreds to thousands of ads at a time, so there's real room to grow your output and your pay here.



THE SCREENING TEST (REQUIRED)



Before you apply, generate 2 to 3 sample images that include all three of the following in one image: a person, branding, and a real environment.



Completing this is required, not optional.



To apply, start your application with the word CREATIVE so we know you read this whole post.



Any application that skips the sample images, skips the CREATIVE keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a hard gate.



HOW TO APPLY



A recording is mandatory. Submit either a Loom video (strongly preferred) or a Vocaroo voice recording (
).



In your recording, cover:

1. Your name and location.

2. What AI tools you use and how you make your images look realistic for ads.

3. What sets you apart from other candidates when we consider bringing you on the team.



Applicants who submit sample images correctly and include a recording are the only ones we'll consider for an interview. No recording, no interview.



The recording is also how we screen English fluency and personality for a role where you'll get fast, direct feedback constantly, so speak clearly and naturally. Be yourself.



Roof Ignite Ltd. is a marketing agency.

title: CREATING STRATEGIST - DTC ECOM UP TO 5K USD/MO
description:
Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST

Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process:



Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?



What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?



Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.



What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?



Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?



How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?



Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?



How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?



Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?



You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.

The Social Media Manager (SMM) will play a critical role in supporting the CEO by managing administrative tasks, optimizing processes, and overseeing project workflows. This role will evolve over time, with new responsibilities added as the candidate becomes integrated into the team. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, self-driven, and proactive, with a passion for improving systems and supporting a team.

Please do not use AI to respond to this posting, we will be checking, and you will be disqualified. We want to see you write like a human!



About Our Company



At CJAM Marketing, we believe in building strong relationships and fostering a culture of trust and transparency. We're a team of passionate individuals who are committed to helping brands find the perfect marketing partners to fuel their growth.



Company Values:



Radically transparent



Being transparent makes sure nothing is missed and that we have the best information to make decisions from. Sometimes that means sharing information that someone may not want to hear but helps the business move forward.



Building long-term relationships



We try to build as many long term relationships as possible, which means, communication, openness and ability to take and give feedback is extremely important.



A-players only



A-players are people who take pride in what they do, and will do their best to succeed at their tasks. This doesn't mean working yourself past capacity, but it means doing the best you can do and moving the business forward.



Do the right thing always



Ask yourself, is this the right thing to do? And if the answer is no, go back to the drawing board.



Constantly grow and share knowledge



The marketing space and business shifts so fast. It is up to each person to constantly grow and share their knowledge as things progress. We move forward together.

Social Media Management

, TikTok) using pre-written captions and client-provided photos and videos (while adding closed captions and overlay text in-platform.)

, and LinkedIn, including responding to comments and sending DMs.

- Have 2 years of experience as a Social Media Manager, including in developing strategic ideas, editing content, posting content, and measuring results.

- Extremely detail-oriented with a strong drive to complete work with minimal management.

- Enjoys working in a support role, with a preference for working independently or in smaller team settings.

- Analytical mindset with a passion for researching and improving processes.

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- Familiarity with ClickUp (or similar project management tools) for task tracking and management.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Slack.

- Excellent communication skills for coordinating with tea
mbers and the CEO.

- Must have cellphone, laptop and high internet speed



Deliverables and Key Outcomes:



- Success in this role will be measured by the candidate's ability to:

-Improve team social media processes and take ownership of the social media 

-Deliver actionable, timely reports that enable data-driven decision-making.

-Develop ideas and manage testing of ideas that may drive social media lead generation.

CAD (Canadian dollar) part-time ( 30-40 hours)  (overtime we expect this position could grow into a full-time role)

If you believe you're a great fit for this role, please send your resume and portfolio of social accounts you have worked on to 
 your
, include a 2-minute video with a brief introduction about yourself, why this role excites you, and examples of your portfolio of social media accounts you've managed. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

/Instagram) campaigns. You'll work with our marketing team to turn briefs into scroll-stopping creative, iterate quickly based on performance data, and use AI image tools to speed up production without sacrificing quality.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
We are an outsourced cold calling and sales development agency (HTC Sales Consulting / Revenue Drivers). B2B technology and services companies in the US and Canada hire us to book qualified sales meetings for them. You will be cold calling US businesses on behalf of our clients.



THE JOB



You are a full time cold caller who will grow into managing 2 to 4 client campaigns at once. We provide everything: lead lists, scripts, campaign briefs, the dialer (FrontSpin), the CRM (Salesforce), Slack for communication, and real coaching (call reviews, script work). You sit down, dial, have great conversations, and book meetings.



What makes us different: most cold callers connect with 2 to 8 people per 100 dials. Our data gets you 15 to 25 connects per 100 dials. More conversations means more meetings and more commission. It also means real work: at full capacity you will have 32 to 48 live conversations per day across your accounts. This role is for someone who can handle that volume day after day without burning out.



You start on ONE client account. Hit your quota, get stable, then we add a second, third, and fourth account. Every account you add increases your pay.



THE PAY (all amounts in USD)



- Base salary: $1,000 per month

- Commission: $30 to $40 per booked meeting that shows up, depending on the campaign

- Typical quota: 8 to 12 showed meetings per client per month

- What that adds up to:

- 1 client: about $1,300 to $1,400 per month

- 2 clients: about $1,600 to $1,800

- 3 clients: about $1,900 to $2,200

- 4 clients: about $2,200 to $2,600 and up

- Growth path: caller to team lead to SDR manager within 3 to 6 months for the right person, with higher base and overrides on the team you lead



WHO WE WANT



- You have done high volume outbound calling and you know your numbers (dials, connects, meetings booked)

- You can do repetitive work for months without losing sight of the goal

- You improve on your own: you review your calls, track your stats, and adjust

- You think in systems: when results drop, you look for the cause before asking for new tools

- You want to grow inside a company long term, not run your own side business



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken English, comfortable talking to US executives

- Available US Eastern business hours (night shift if you are in the Philippines)

- 50 hours per week, full time, no other job

- B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience strongly preferred

- Experience with a dialer and CRM (FrontSpin, Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, or similar)

- Quiet workspace, good headset, reliable computer, stable internet; backup power or internet is a big plus



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, applications that skip a step are rejected)



1. Start your application with the word DIALTONE so we know you read this far

2. Record a video, 3 minutes maximum, camera on: walk us through the most repetitive thing you have ever done for months at a time, the numbers you held while doing it, and how you kept it from going stale. Paste a public link (Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube).

3. Answer this: what is the most live conversations you have sustained per day, and for how long?

title: Programmatic Advertising Admin Operations VA
description:
PROGRAMMATIC ADVERTISING ADMIN OPERATIONS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT



The Blended Group | Remote (Contractor) | Part-Time



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Blended Group is an influencer marketing and talent management agency working with tech and AI brands. We're looking for a Programmatic Advertising Admin Operations Virtual Assistant to bridge ad technology and business operations — someone who's comfortable in the backend of DSP platforms one minute and cleaning up a billing tracker the next.



This role handles the day-to-day execution of programmatic campaigns (buying and selling ad inventory through automated platforms) and manages the routine financial, administrative, and reporting work that keeps a marketing team running smoothly. You'll be the person who makes sure campaigns are set up correctly, spend is tracked accurately, and reports are ready before anyone has to ask for them.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Campaign Administration

- Set up and configure programmatic campaigns across DSPs including Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, Google Ads (DV360/Google Display & Video 360 experience a plus), and other specialized ad servers

- Build out targeting parameters, audience segments, budgets, flight dates, and bid strategies per campaign brief

- Traffic ad tags and tracking pixels; QA campaigns before launch to confirm they're configured correctly

- Monitor active campaigns for delivery issues, pacing problems, or platform errors and flag/resolve promptly



Financial Operations

- Track ad spend against approved budgets across all active campaigns and platforms

- Manage campaign invoices — collecting, organizing, and reconciling against insertion orders/contracts

- Check for payment and billing discrepancies between platform spend and vendor invoices

- Maintain and update billing trackers so spend status is always current and easy to audit



Data & Reporting

- Pull raw performance data from DSPs and ad platforms and consolidate it into clean, easy-to-read reports

- Build and maintain dashboards in Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and/or Excel/Sheets

- Track and report on core metrics: ROAS, CTR, CPM, CPC, conversion rate, and pacing vs. budget

- Deliver recurring (weekly/monthly) performance summaries to the marketing team, flagging wins and areas of concern



Quality Assurance

- Review ad creatives (images, video, copy) against each platform's specifications and guidelines before submission

- Troubleshoot broken tracking links, rejected creatives, and other pre-launch or in-flight issues

- Maintain a QA checklist/SOP so creative and tracking issues get caught before they become client-facing problems



ESSENTIAL TECH STACK & QUALIFICATIONS



Required:

- Hands-on experience setting up and managing campaigns in at least one major DSP — Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, or Google DV360/Google Ads — with working knowledge of programmatic buying fundamentals (audience targeting, bid strategy, pacing, frequency capping)

- Comfortable navigating Meta 
/Instagram) Ads Manager for campaign setup and reporting

- Strong Google Workspace skills (Sheets, Docs, Looker Studio) and Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, basic dashboarding)

- Experience with Google Analytics or a comparable analytics/attribution tool

- Familiarity with project management tools — we use ClickUp (Asana or Trello experience is also fine, we'll train on ClickUp)

- Excellent written English and strong attention to detail — this role touches client billing and reporting, so accuracy matters

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet home-office setup for calls



Nice to have:

- Amazon Ads or Amazon DSP certification, Trade Desk Edge Academy certification, or Google Ads/Analytics certification

- Prior experience working with a US-based agency or marketing team

- Familiarity with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) or other retail media platforms (Walmart Connect, Criteo)

- Experience troubleshooting UTM parameters and third-party tracking pixels



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Campaigns launch on time, configured correctly, with no avoidable QA issues

- Budget trackers and billing records are accurate and current — no surprises at reconciliation

- Reports are clear, on schedule, and require minimal back-and-forth to understand

- The marketing team trusts you to flag problems (pacing, discrepancies, creative rejections) before they're asked



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



- Independent contractor role, part-time

- Pay rate: $5/hour (USD)

- Working hours overlapping US Pacific or Eastern time preferred

- Remote — work from anywhere with a reliable connection



HOW TO APPLY



Applicants must submit all of the following — incomplete applications will not be considered:

1. Updated resume or CV

2. Portfolio link (Google Drive, Notion, Behance, or personal site) showing prior campaign or reporting work

3. A short cover letter (3–5 sentences): describe your experience, the platforms you know best, and one result you're proud of from a past client

4. If you read this far, include "MediaBlended" in the subject line of your application

5. Your available start date and preferred working hours (US Pacific or Eastern time preferred)

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



We are a B2B marketing agency serving manufacturing and industrial companies across North America. Our clients operate in fabrication shops, engineering firms, and construction services, industries where buyers are engineers, operations managers, and procurement teams who expect substance, not fluff.



We help them cut through the noise by producing content and campaigns that actually connect with the people making purchasing decisions in technical industries.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who can write with authority on technical subjects, design visuals that communicate clearly, and execute campaigns from start to finish. You will work directly with leadership and own a meaningful piece of our marketing output from day one.



This is not a role for someone who pastes AI output and calls it done. We use AI as a starting point and apply real expertise to make the output sharp, accurate, and on-brand. You need to know when AI gets it wrong and fix it before it goes anywhere near a client.





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



These four are hard requirements. If you do not have all of them, please do not apply.



1. Highly fluent or native-level English. You will produce client-facing content in English every day. This cannot be developed on the job.



2.
 marketing expertise. You must have hands-on experience building and executing campaigns end to end including list segmentation, copywriting, template design, A/B testing, and performance reporting. Platforms such as Mailchimp, HubSpot, Klaviyo, or ActiveCampaign required.



3. SEO proficiency. You must be able to conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, monitor rankings, and produce clear performance reports. Working knowledge of SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Google Search Console required.



4. Basic web updates. You must be comfortable making routine updates in WordPress or a similar CMS including page edits, blog publishing, and layout adjustments. You do not need to be a developer but you cannot be afraid of the backend.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Content and writing: Research and write technical content for manufacturing and industrial audiences including
