title: CRO Designer (Shopify / E-commerce)
description:
Summary

CRO Designer

(E-commerce / DR Marketing) Fully Remote

Schedule: Flexible (set your own hours)

Employment Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary, paid in USD



Company Overview

- We operate multiple successful e-commerce brands in the skincare and health & wellness sectors, consistently achieving 7-figure monthly revenues. Our brands are heavily focused on direct response marketing, creative testing, and funnel optimization. We are scaling aggressively toward 9-figure annual revenue.



Why Join Us?

- Own the conversion layer of 8-figure DTC brands, with enough traffic to get a clean read on every test.

- Bridge the gap between classic direct response funnels and cutting-edge AI production.

- Full ownership of the CRO pipeline, from insight to shipped variant.

- Work with a highly ambitious team that already buys the traffic, your work compounds immediately.



Role Summary

- As a CRO Designer, you will own everything that happens after the click. Your primary focus is designing and testing high-converting Shopify experiences  advertorials, landing pages, product pages, upsell flows  that turn our media spend into profit.

- You must have a deep understanding of Direct Response (DR) principles. We are not looking for someone who falls in love with a design; we are looking for someone who is right.

- You will work closely with the Creative Strategy, Media Buying and Growth teams to make sure the promise made in the ad survives the click and converts.



Key Responsibilities

- Design and iterate high-converting Shopify landing pages, advertorials, PDPs and funnels across multiple brands.

- Own the CRO testing roadmap: hypothesis, variant, result, next.

- Design A/B and multivariate tests and own the readout,  what won, what lost, and why.

- Design ad-to-page continuity in lockstep with the creative pipeline.

- Design AOV mechanics: bundles, upsells, cross-sells, subscription offers, cart drawers.



Requirements (Must-Have)

- Proven DR Background: Extensive experience in CRO for direct response e-commerce.

- Proven Results: A track record of tests you ran end to end, with the numbers to back them.

- Deep Shopify: Themes, page builders (GemPages or similar), and the app ecosystem.

- Paid Traffic Fluency: You've designed specifically for Meta traffic and know why it behaves differently from organic.

- Tooling: Fluent in Figma; comfortable enough in HTML/CSS (and Liquid) to brief a developer without a translator.

- Analytical Rigor: You can discuss sample size and significance without hand-waving.

- English: Solid written and spoken English, with meaningful CET overlap.



Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Experience in the US market (specifically 40+ female audience).

- DTC experience, ideally in skincare, health, or wellness niches.

- Background in copywriting or scriptwriting for high-converting VSLs and advertorials.

- Klaviyo, TripleWhale or Northbeam experience.

- Funnel building platform knowledge (Checkoutchamp, funnelish etc.) +

- Deep hands-on AI experience.



Ideal Candidate Profile

- Performance Obsessed: You care more about CTR and CVR than winning design awards.

- Versatile: You can write an advertorial headline, mock a section, or design a static if the team needs a hand.

- Fast & Agile: You thrive in a high-pressure environment where speed is a competitive advantage.

- The "AI Architect": You use AI tools to move from insight to wireframe to shipped variant in days, not weeks.



Important

This is not a traditional "web design" role. We are looking for a CRO Designer who understands that data dictates art.



To Apply: 

You must answer all the questions below. 

1. Please send us your updated Linkedn/Upwork profile or CV with google drive link (make sure that it's visible to everyone)

2. Please share one link (portfolio, case study doc, or drive link) showing 2–3 CRO works you ran end-to-end for a DTC e-commerce brands (hypothesis, variant, result).

3. Which AI tools do you use in your creative designs, and how do they impact your production speed/quality? Please explain briefly

4. Choose the areas you have experience with. In your answer, list the letters that apply to you (e.g., "A, C, E, G").

A. Shopify Page Building (Replo, Shogun, GemPages, PageFly)

B. Advertorial & Pre-Lander Design (Listicles, editorials for cold traffic)

C. Product Page (PDP) Optimization

D. Checkout, Cart & Post-Purchase Flows (Upsells, cart drawers, bumps)

E. AOV Mechanics (Bundles, cross-sells, subscription offers)

F. Funnel Analytics (GA4, Shopify Analytics, heatmaps, session recordings)

G. Ad-to-Page Continuity (Designing specifically for Meta traffic)

H. Front-End Implementation (HTML/CSS, Liquid, theme edits)

I. AI Workflow Automation (Using AI to speed up production)

J. Direct Response Copywriting (Headlines, offers, angles)

K. Other (please specify)

title: YouTube Podcast Editor | 1 Podcast + 3 Shorts Weekly | Long-Term
description:
If you ignore my instructions on how to apply, I will not consider you :)



Each week, I need:

- One lightly edited 60–90 minute interview podcast

- Three vertical shorts selected from that podcast



I am not looking for someone to MrBeast-ify the videos. I do not want constant zooms, sound effects, 
s, or visual clutter.



I want someone who can make a long conversation feel clean and easy to watch.



I make videos about speed cubing - solving Rubik's cubes competitively. I interview many of the fastest and most influential speed cubers, and am well respected within this niche community!



I will pay $75 USD per podcast and 3 accompanying shorts.  I'm estimating this job will be 6-8 hrs per week in total - I do not want super complex edits or motion graphics.  Once we establish that you understand speed cubing and are making shorts that get views, I'm willing to raise it to $90 USD per pod + shorts.



Foror Each Podcast, you would:

- Download the raw footage from Riverside

- Work with the individual speaker camera and audio tracks

- Create a short cold open using strong 
nts from later in the conversation

- Cut dead space, awkward starts and stops, repeated thoughts, technical issues, and sections that clearly do not need to be there

- Switch naturally between individual speakers and split-screen layouts

- Add supplied calls to action at appropriate points

- Do basic audio cleanup and leveling

- Export and deliver the finished episode



These are conversational interviews. I do not want them cut so aggressively that they stop feeling natural.



 For Each Short, you would identify three strong 
nts from the full conversation and turn them into vertical clips.



I do not want three AI-generated clips exported without much thought.  I can do that myself.



The goal is to build the best clip from the whole conversation. If the context, setup, and payoff happen at different points, pull those 
nts together and reorder them so the clip makes sense on its own.



The clips should:

- Make sense without requiring the viewer to have seen the podcast

- Include enough context to understand why the 
nt matters

- Be sharp and tightened where necessary

- Have accurate, readable captions

- Feel like something a person would watch and think, “That was a good clip. I should watch the full podcast.”



From the time you get footage, I expect a first draft of the podcast + clips back within 5 days, and any revisions back within 3 days.  I'm guessing we will need 1 set of revisions per episode.







I care about skill, not experience.



You do not need to know anything about speed cubing before applying, but you should be willing to learn enough about the niche as we work together to understand which 
nts matter.



I will do paid test projects with anyone I'm interested in.



1. I'll give you 15 minutes of raw podcast footage to edit. Edit it and give me 1 clip. (Paid)

2. If you pass that, I'll let you edit a full podcast + make 3 clips. (Paid)



If that goes well and you are responsive to feedback, we'll move into a long-term relationship.



Job Requirements



- Clear written English

- Replies within 24 hours on normal working days

- Ability to meet an agreed weekly deadline

- Reliable internet access for downloading and uploading large video files

- Willingness to complete one normal revision round when needed





HOW TO APPLY



Please submit 2–3 podcast or interview episodes you personally helped edit.



For each podcast, include:

* A link to the full podcast episode

* A link to at least one vertical clip created from that same episode

* A brief explanation of exactly what you handled on the project



I want to evaluate both your long-form editing and your ability to identify and build clips from the full conversation. Please do not submit unrelated podcast examples and shorts from different projects.



Your examples should be formatted like this:

Podcast 1

Full episode:

Clip from this episode:

What I handled:



Podcast 2

Full episode:

Clip from this episode:

What I handled:



Please only submit work you personally edited or substantially contributed to. If you only handled part of the podcast or clip, clearly explain your role.



General demo reels, unrelated short-form edits, gaming montages, and shorts that cannot be connected to a podcast you edited will not be considered.



I care more about the quality of your work than your years of experience.



You do not need to know anything about speedcubing before applying, but you should be willing to learn enough about the niche to understand which 
nts matter.

title: Social Media Content & Editing Virtual Assistant
description:
Social Media Content & Video Editing Virtual Assistant



Company: PerfectPints Network LLC

Position: Social Media Content & Video Editing Virtual Assistant

Hours: Approximately 10 to 15 hours per week to start

Schedule: Flexible, with consistent availability throughout the week

Work Type: Remote



About PerfectPints Network



PerfectPints Network LLC is a growing digital media and entertainment network focused on sports, social media, original content, and digital experiences.



We are looking to hire our first Virtual Assistant to become an important part of our growing content operation. This is not a traditional administrative VA position. We are looking for someone creative who understands social media culture, internet trends, short-form content, and what makes people stop scrolling.



The ideal candidate is someone who actively follows social media trends and understands how to adapt them to fit a specific brand rather than simply copying what is popular.



Primary Responsibilities



Social Media Trend Research



Regularly monitor platforms including Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, sports media pages, creator accounts, and other relevant social platforms.



You will be responsible for identifying:



* Trending content formats

* Relevant 
s and internet trends

* Trending sounds and audio

* Sports and entertainment topics

* Viral hooks and video concepts

* Content ideas that can be adapted specifically for PerfectPints



Trends and ideas should be organized with the appropriate PerfectPints page, suggested concept, reference link, and level of urgency.



Expected output: Approximately 10 to 15 quality, brand-relevant content opportunities per week.



Short-Form Video Editing



Edit raw footage provided by the PerfectPints team into engaging short-form content for platforms including:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts



Editors should understand:



* Strong opening hooks

* Audience retention

* Short-form pacing

* Removing unnecessary dead space

* Clean and engaging captions

* Strategic cuts and zooms

* Sound effects

* Music and trending audio

* 
s and relevant graphics

* Vertical video formatting



The goal is to create entertaining, modern content that feels natural to the platform while remaining consistent with the PerfectPints brand.



Expected output: Approximately 5 to 10 completed short-form videos per week, depending on the complexity of each project.



Content Management & Organization



Help maintain an organized content workflow from initial idea through publication.



Content will be tracked through stages such as:



Idea ? Needs Filming ? Raw Footage Ready ? Editing ? Review ? Approved ? Scheduled ? Posted



You will be responsible for ensuring assigned content is properly organized and that project statuses remain updated.



This may include tracking:



* Content title

* PerfectPints page or brand

* Content category

* Current status

* Shooting date

* Scheduled posting date

* Final video file

* Caption status



Content Submission & Revisions



Completed videos will initially be submitted for approval before publication.



Content may be marked:



* Approved

* Revision Needed

* Rejected



You will be expected to handle reasonable revisions based on feedback and maintain an organized approval process.



As you become more familiar with the PerfectPints brand, recurring content formats may become pre-approved and require less direct oversight.



Weekly Expectations



The position will initially require approximately 10 to 15 hours per week.



A typical week may include:



* 2 to 3 hours of trend research and content ideation

* 6 to 8 hours of short-form video editing

* 1 to 2 hours of content organization and file management

* Approximately 1 hour for revisions, communication, and weekly review



At the end of each week, we expect:



* 10+ researched and relevant content opportunities

* 5 to 10 completed short-form video edits

* Assigned raw footage to be edited or properly tracked

* Content workflow and calendar to remain updated

* Organized project and final video files

* A brief weekly update covering completed work, outstanding approvals, and trends that should be acted on quickly



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Is proficient in short-form video editing

* Understands TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Actively follows social media and internet culture

* Understands what makes content engaging and shareable

* Can identify trends early and adapt them creatively

* Has a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and viewer retention

* Is organized and able to manage multiple pieces of content

* Communicates clearly and responds well to feedback

* Can work independently without needing constant direction

* Understands the difference between following a trend and forcing a trend that does not fit a brand



Knowledge of sports, sports media, sports betting culture, entertainment, and creator-driven content is strongly preferred.



Preferred Tools & Experience



Experience with platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software is preferred.



Experience with content management platforms such as Notion is a plus.



We are not simply looking for someone who knows how to edit videos. We are looking for someone who can eventually become a reliable part of the PerfectPints content operation and help turn raw footage, ideas, and trends into consistent, ready-to-publish content.



This position has the potential to grow in responsibilities and weekly hours as PerfectPints Network continues to expand.

title: Closer / Recruiter - Run Zoom Interviews for US Roofing Companies (Night Shift + Bonuses)
description:
Start your application with the word CLOSER at the very top. Applications without it are deleted unread.**



The short version



$1,000/mo base. Up to $1,050/mo more in bonuses. Night shift (9pm–6am Manila). You run Zoom interviews with American sales candidates and d
 who's good enough to send to our clients.



If you've ever closed anything - you can do this job.



Who we are



Building With Systems is a US recruiting agency. We build door-to-door sales teams for roofing companies across the United States. Five active clients. Real pipeline. Four years in business.



We have a setter who handles all outreach and booking. That part is solved.



What we don't have is a closer.



What the role actually is



Warm candidates come to you already booked onto a group intro call. You run the call. You read the room. You d
 who's worth a 1-on-1. You run the 1-on-1. You make the call: qualified, not qualified, or needs more info. Then you keep the good ones warm until they walk into the client's office.



This is a sales role wearing a recruiting badge. You're not screening resumes. You're reading people, and you're selling a hard job: door-to-door sales - to people who have options.



When the pipeline is light, you hunt. LinkedIn, Indeed, direct outreach, phone. You don't sit and wait to be fed.



The money



Base: $1,000/month** — full time, 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday



$100 for every rep who's still with a client past 30 days



$150 bonus in any month where more than 5 reps hit the 30-day mark



Do the math on a strong month: 8 reps stick past 30 days = $800 in placement bonuses + $150 threshold bonus = $950 on top of base.



We want to pay you that. It's cheaper for us than a bad closer.



Why the bonus is tied to 30-day retention and not to who you send: because it protects quality. A wrong placement that quits in week one costs you money. A right placement that sticks pays you. Your incentive and our incentive are the same thing. That's on purpose.



The hours — read this carefully



9am–6pm US Eastern = roughly 9pm–6am Manila time. Monday through Friday.



This is a night shift. If you can't reliably work nights and be sharp on camera at 3am Manila time, stop reading — this will not work and we'll both waste our time.



The camera requirement



You're on Zoom with American candidates every day. Non-negotiable:



- Camera on, always

- Clean, professional background

- Stable internet (backup connection required)

- Clear audio, no echo, no background noise



If your setup isn't ready on day one, apply again when it is. We mean that — we'd rather hear from you in two months with a real setup.



What you'll actually do day to day



- Run 20-minute group intro calls on Zoom

- Read the room — who's engaged, who's checked out, who's wasting your time

- Run 1-on-1 interviews within 48 hours of every group call

- Make a hard yes/no on every candidate

- Send qualified people to the client office and keep them warm until they show up

- Hunt your own candidates when the pipeline is thin

- Update the GHL pipeline daily — every stage move logged before you close your laptop

- Send a daily update to leadership without being asked



You're a fit if



- Your English is clear, confident, and natural. Americans need to trust you in the first 30 seconds.

- You've done sales, recruiting, setting, or anything where you had to persuade someone who wasn't sure.

- You can read people fast — real interest vs. polite interest inside 5 minutes.

- You're comfortable commanding a room on camera.

- You follow up relentlessly without being reminded.

- You can tell someone they're not a fit and sleep fine.

- You looked at the bonus structure and immediately started doing the math.



What you get that most VA roles don't



- A setter feeding you appointments — you're not cold-calling all day

- Direct access to the founder, not a layer of managers

- Real US sales experience on your resume — group presentations, 1-on-1 closing, pipeline ownership

- Comp that's uncapped on the upside, tied to something you actually control

- A company that's been doing this four years, not a startup that disappears in 90 days



How to apply — two things, that's it

title: B2B Outbound Sales Representative

Outbound Prospecting

Use AI tools to personalize messaging and scale outreach without sacrificing quality

Qualification & Discovery

Qualify hard; don't pass along deals that won't close or clients who won't be a good fit

Book qualified meetings and hand off clean, well-documented opportunities to the CEO

Manage longer, multi-touch cycles — keep deals warm and moving without letting them go cold

Document everything in the CRM accurately and consistently

Collaboration



Work closely with the CEO on targeting and handoff

Share market feedback: objections you hear, what's resonating, what isn't

Contribute to improving pitch materials,
 sequences, and sales collateralal

Must Have



Real, demonstrable B2B sales experience selling complex or considered products/services (multiple stakeholders, longer cycles) — a hard requirement, not entry-level

Track record in outbound prospecting; be ready to talk numbers

Hands-on experience prospecting via LinkedIn and cold
 (not phone-only)

Strong spoken and written English; you'll be reaching out to US clients

Comfortable using a CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar) and modern prospecting tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

You Are a Fit If



You're motivated by outcomes, not activity metrics

You follow up relentlessly — no deal dies because you forgot to send an

You can take feedback on your pitch and improve fast

Nice to Have



Experience selling digital marketing, AI, SaaS, or other tech-enabled services

Familiarity with the US SMB or agency market

Experience running your own outbound sequences end-to-end

$800 – $1,200 USD/month depending on experience

Remote; full-time or part-time (your choice)

Real autonomy over your prospecting strategy — if it works, we scale it

Short sales cycle with competitive pricing that's easy to defend

Direct access to decision-makers — no internal bureaucracy slowing deals down

A company that reinvests in its team when targets are hit
